الأذان يوم الحج الأكبر: The proclamation on the Day of the Greater Hajj
منع المشركين من المسجد الحرام: Barring idolaters from the Sacred Mosque
الأشهر الحرم والنسيء: The sacred months and postponing them
الأذان بالحج وتطهير البيت والطواف: The call to Hajj, purifying the House and the Tawaf
تعظيم الشعائر والهدي: Honouring the symbols and the sacrifice
دخول المسجد الحرام محلقين ومقصرين: Entering the Sacred Mosque shaved or shortened
ركنٌ جامع للمرأة كما ذكرها القرآن الكريم: A comprehensive corner on women as the Noble Quran mentions them: the women it names and their stories, her standing and rights, her circumstances and rulings, and what Allah legislated to protect her and preserve her dignity, each with its verses, its exegesis and verbatim quotations from the books of tafsir.
نساء أخريات في قصص القرآن: More women in the stories of the Quran
أسكنها إبراهيم بوادٍ غير ذي زرع عند البي: Abraham settled her in a barren valley by the Sacred House
ترك إبراهيم عليه السلام زوجه وولده بوادٍ: Abraham, peace be upon him, left his wife and son in a valley without crops by the Sacred House and prayed for them; through her patience and trust in Allah, Makkah began to be inhabited.
امرأة زكريا عليه السلام: The wife of Zechariah, peace be upon him
وُهب لها يحيى بعد العقم والكبر: Granted John after barrenness and old age
كانت عاقراً وقد بلغ زكريا الكبر، فوهب ال: She was barren and Zechariah had reached old age, yet Allah granted them John, a sign that the power of Allah is not bound by worldly means.
بنات لوط عليه السلام: The daughters of Lot, peace be upon him
دعا قومه إلى النكاح الحلال: He called his people to lawful marriage
قال لوط عليه السلام لقومه: «هؤلاء بناتي: Lot, peace be upon him, told his people: "These are my daughters; they are purer for you," calling them to lawful marriage instead of indecency; many exegetes said he meant the women of his nation.
مثلٌ لمن ينقض العهد بعد توكيده: A parable for breaking a pledge after confirming it
ضرب الله بها المثل لمن ينقض عهده بعد توك: Allah made her a parable for whoever breaks a pledge after confirming it, like one who spins her yarn and then unravels it into strands.
حفصة وعائشة رضي الله عنهما: Hafsa and Aisha, may Allah be pleased with them
حفظ أسرار البيت والتوبة إلى الله: Keeping the secrets of the home, and repentance
أسرّ النبي ﷺ إلى بعض أزواجه حديثاً فأفشت: The Prophet ﷺ confided something to one of his wives and she disclosed it, so Allah called the two of them to repentance; it teaches the etiquette of keeping the secrets of the home.
المرأة التي وهبت نفسها للنبي ﷺ: The woman who offered herself to the Prophet ﷺ
حكم من خصائص النبي ﷺ: A ruling particular to the Prophet ﷺ
أحلّ الله لنبيه ﷺ امرأةً مؤمنة إن وهبت ن: Allah made lawful for His Prophet ﷺ a believing woman who offered herself to him, exclusively for him and not for the other believers; it is a ruling particular to him ﷺ.
حمايتها وكرامتها في الأحكام: Her protection and dignity in the rulings
حماية العرض وحدّ القذف: Protecting honour: the penalty for slander
عقوبة من يرمي المحصنات: The punishment for accusing chaste women
شدّد الله عقوبة من يرمي المحصنات بغير بي: Allah made severe the punishment for accusing chaste women without proof: the prescribed penalty, rejection of his testimony, and the name of transgressor, except for those who repent.
إذا اتهم الزوج زوجه ولا شهود له: When a husband accuses his wife without witnesses
شرع الله اللعان بين الزوجين إذا اتهم الر: Allah legislated li'an between spouses when a man accuses his wife and has no witnesses; the punishment is averted from her if she testifies four times by Allah.
لا هجر بيمين فوق أربعة أشهر: No abandonment by oath beyond four months
منع الله أن يحلف الرجل على هجر امرأته أك: Allah forbade a man from swearing to abandon his wife for more than four months, to lift harm from her: he either returns to her or divorces.
عدة الوفاة: The waiting period of a widow
جعل الله عدة المتوفى عنها زوجها أربعة أش: Allah set the waiting period of a widow at four months and ten days; after it she may decide for herself in what is right.
أوجب الله للمطلقات متاعاً بالمعروف حقاً: Allah prescribed for divorced women a provision according to what is right, a duty upon the God-fearing, to console them and to be kind at parting.
المؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض: Believing men and women are allies of one another
جعل الله المؤمنين والمؤمنات أولياء بعض،: Allah made believing men and women allies of one another, enjoining good, forbidding evil and establishing prayer; the woman is a partner in reform.
بهتان وإثم مبين: A slander and a manifest sin
توعّد الله من يؤذي المؤمنين والمؤمنات بغ: Allah warned that whoever harms believing men and women for what they have not earned bears a slander and a manifest sin.
فتنة المؤمنات في دينهن: Persecuting believing women for their faith
وعيد لمن عذّبهن ثم لم يتب: A warning to those who tormented them and did not repent
توعّد الله الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنا: Allah threatened those who persecuted believing men and women for their faith and then did not repent with the punishment of Hell and of burning.
ركنٌ جامع للرجل كما ذكره القرآن الكريم:: A comprehensive corner on men as the Noble Quran mentions them: men other than the prophets whom it names and their stories, the qualities of true manhood and of the believers, and his responsibilities and rulings, each with its verses, its exegesis and verbatim quotations from the books of tafsir.
رجال آخرون في قصص القرآن: More men in the stories of the Quran
الفتية أصحاب الكهف: The young men of the Cave
شباب آمنوا بربهم فزادهم الله هدى: Youths who believed, and Allah increased them in guidance
شبابٌ آمنوا بربهم فزادهم الله هدى، وربط: Young men who believed in their Lord, so Allah increased them in guidance and strengthened their hearts, and they stood for monotheism before their people.
أصحاب الأخدود والغلام: The People of the Trench and the boy
قومٌ عُذّبوا بالنار في الأخدود لأنهم آمن: A people tormented with fire in the trench because they believed in Allah, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy; its exegesis tells the story of the boy who stood firm in monotheism.
أماته الله مائة عام ثم بعثه: Allah caused him to die for a hundred years, then raised him
أماته الله مائة عام ثم بعثه، فلما تبيّن: Allah caused him to die for a hundred years and then raised him; when it became clear to him he said: I know that Allah has power over all things.
الذي حاجّ إبراهيم في ربه: The one who disputed with Abraham about his Lord
ملك طغى فبُهت أمام الحجة: A tyrant king left dumbfounded by the proof
ملكٌ آتاه الله الملك فطغى وجادل إبراهيم: A king to whom Allah had given kingship, who transgressed and disputed with Abraham about his Lord; Abraham established the proof against him and the disbeliever was dumbfounded.
دعوة الأب إلى التوحيد برفق: Calling a father to monotheism with gentleness
دعا إبراهيم عليه السلام أباه إلى التوحيد: Abraham, peace be upon him, called his father to monotheism and to abandon idols; the story shows that guidance is not inherited through kinship.
أضلّ بني إسرائيل بالعجل: He led the Children of Israel astray with the calf
أضلّ بني إسرائيل بعجلٍ جسدٍ له خوار، فكا: He led the Children of Israel astray with a calf, a body that lowed, and became an example of one who tempts people away from their religion.
الذي انسلخ من آيات الله: The one who cast off the signs of Allah
آتاه الله آياته فانسلخ منها واتبع هواه،: Allah gave him His signs but he cast them off and followed his desire, so Allah likened him to a dog, a warning against knowledge without action.
كفران النعمة وعناد الحق: Ingratitude for blessings and stubbornness against the truth
آتاه الله مالاً ممدوداً وبنين شهوداً، فع: Allah gave him abundant wealth and sons at his side, yet he stubbornly opposed the signs of Allah, a lesson in ingratitude for blessings.
صاحب النبي ﷺ في الغار: The Companion of the Prophet ﷺ in the cave
لا تحزن إن الله معنا: Do not grieve; Allah is with us
قال النبي ﷺ لصاحبه في الغار: «لا تحزن إن: The Prophet ﷺ said to his companion in the cave: "Do not grieve; Allah is with us," and Allah sent down His tranquillity upon him; the exegetes agree that the companion was Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him.
الثلاثة الذين خُلّفوا: The three who were left behind
تخلّفوا عن غزوة تبوك ثم صدقوا، فضاقت علي: They stayed behind from the expedition of Tabuk and then told the truth; the earth, vast as it is, closed in on them until Allah accepted their repentance; truthfulness was their salvation.
الأعمى الذي جاء يسعى: The blind man who came eagerly
جاء يطلب العلم فعاتب الله نبيه ﷺ لأجله،: He came seeking knowledge, and Allah gently reproached His Prophet ﷺ for his sake; it shows that a man's worth lies in his eagerness for guidance, not his rank among his people.
أبرهة وأصحاب الفيل: Abraha and the People of the Elephant
جاء يهدم الكعبة فحمى الله بيته: He came to destroy the Kaaba and Allah protected His House
جاء بجيشه وفيله ليهدم الكعبة، فأرسل الله: He came with his army and elephant to destroy the Kaaba, and Allah sent against them birds in flocks, protecting His House.
خصال الرجولة كما يرسمها القرآن: Qualities of true manhood in the Quran
خُلُق إسماعيل عليه السلام: The character of Ishmael, peace be upon him
أثنى الله على إسماعيل عليه السلام بأنه ك: Allah praised Ishmael, peace be upon him, for being true to his promise; keeping one's word is a trait of true men.
خُلُق إبراهيم عليه السلام: The character of Abraham, peace be upon him
وصف الله إبراهيم عليه السلام بأنه حليمٌ: Allah described Abraham, peace be upon him, as forbearing, tender-hearted and ever-turning to Him; manhood is forbearance, a soft heart and turning to Allah.
أثنى الله على إبراهيم عليه السلام بأنه و: Allah praised Abraham, peace be upon him, for fulfilling, that is, completing what he was commanded and conveying what he was sent with.
سنة إبراهيم عليه السلام: The way of Abraham, peace be upon him
جاء ضيف إبراهيم المكرمون، فراغ إلى أهله: The honoured guests of Abraham came, and he went quietly to his family, brought a fattened calf and placed it before them; honouring guests became part of the guidance of the prophets.
وأمرهم شورى بينهم: They conduct their affairs by mutual consultation
من صفات المؤمنين التي ذكرها الله أن أمره: Among the qualities of the believers that Allah mentioned is that their affairs are by mutual consultation, so a man does not impose his opinion in what concerns others.
صفة المحسنين: A quality of those who do good
أعدّ الله الجنة للمتقين الذين ينفقون في: Allah prepared Paradise for the God-fearing who spend in ease and hardship, who restrain their anger and pardon people.
الشدة في الحق والرحمة بالمؤمنين: Firm for the truth, merciful to the believers
صفة أصحاب النبي ﷺ: A quality of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ
وصف الله أصحاب النبي ﷺ بأنهم أشداء على ا: Allah described the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ as firm against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves, bowing and prostrating, seeking the bounty and pleasure of Allah.
ربّيون ما وهنوا: Devoted men who did not weaken
كم من نبي قاتل معه ربّيون كثير، فما وهنو: How many a prophet fought alongside many devoted men; they did not weaken for what befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they falter or yield.
أمر الله المؤمنين إذا نودي للصلاة يوم ال: Allah commanded the believers, when the call to prayer is made on Friday, to hasten to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade; the Friday prayer is obligatory upon men.
القتال دفاعاً عن الحق: Fighting in defence of the truth
كُتب عليكم القتال وهو كره لكم: Fighting is prescribed for you though you dislike it
فرض الله القتال في سبيله دفاعاً عن الدين: Allah prescribed fighting in His way in defence of religion and life, though souls dislike it; a person may dislike a thing while it is good for him.
ركن الأسرة في القرآن: The family corner in the Quran
الأسرة كما بناها القرآن الكريم: الزواج و: The family as the Noble Quran built it: marriage and its foundations, parents and children, upbringing at home, family stories in the Quran, what mends relations between spouses, and ties of kinship and inheritance, each with its verses, its exegesis and verbatim quotations from the books of tafsir.
نص الآيات من المصحف، والتفسير من الميسّر: The text of the verses is from the Mushaf, the exegesis from al-Muyassar, and the quotations are verbatim from the included books of tafsir. The introduction is a brief summary; the details of rulings and the views of the schools of law are in the books of fiqh. What concerns women and men specifically is in the "Women's corner" and the "Men's corner", and the family supplications are in "Supplications of the Quran".
أصل الأسرة: نفس واحدة: The origin of the family: a single soul
افتتح الله سورة النساء بأن الناس خُلقوا: Allah opened Surat al-Nisa' by stating that people were created from a single soul, from which its mate was created, and commanded fear of Him and keeping ties of kinship.
الزواج سنة المرسلين: Marriage, the way of the messengers
جعل الله لهم أزواجاً وذرية: Allah gave them wives and offspring
أرسل الله رسلاً من قبل النبي ﷺ وجعل لهم: Allah sent messengers before the Prophet ﷺ and gave them wives and offspring; marriage is part of the guidance of the prophets and does not conflict with prophethood.
وأنكحوا الأيامى منكم: Marry off the unmarried among you
أمر الله بتزويج من لا زوج له من الرجال و: Allah commanded marrying off the unmarried men and women and the righteous among the servants, and promised the poor that He would enrich them from His bounty.
الدين أولاً في الاختيار: Faith first in choosing a spouse
ولأمة مؤمنة خير من مشركة: A believing servant is better than an idolater
جعل الله الإيمان أول ما يُنظر إليه في ال: Allah made faith the first thing to consider in marriage: a believing servant woman is better than an idolatress even if she pleases you, and a believing servant man is better than an idolater.
المحرّمات من النساء: Women whom one may not marry
بيّن الله من يحرم نكاحهن من النسب والرضا: Allah set out whom one may not marry by blood, by nursing and by marriage, to safeguard kinship and the sanctity of homes.
وصف الله كلاً من الزوجين بأنه لباس للآخر: Allah described each spouse as a garment for the other: covering, tranquillity and closeness; it is among the most eloquent descriptions of the marital bond.
الوصية بالوالدين مع الثبات على الحق: Honouring parents while holding to the truth
ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حسناً: We enjoined on man kindness to his parents
أوصى الله بالإحسان إلى الوالدين، فإن جاه: Allah enjoined kindness to parents; if they strive to make the child associate partners with Allah he does not obey them, yet his kindness to them remains.
ولو خالفا في الدين: Even when they differ in religion
أمر الله بمصاحبة الوالدين في الدنيا معرو: Allah commanded keeping company with parents in this world with kindness even if they are idolaters, while following the way of those who turn to Him.
النهي عن قتل الأولاد خشية الفقر: Forbidding the killing of children for fear of poverty
نحن نرزقهم وإياكم: We provide for them and for you
نهى الله عن قتل الأولاد خشية الفقر، وتكف: Allah forbade killing children for fear of poverty, guaranteed their provision and that of their parents, and declared killing them a great sin.
والباقيات الصالحات خير: And the enduring good deeds are better
المال والبنون زينة الحياة الدنيا، والأعم: Wealth and children are the adornment of the life of this world, while the enduring good deeds are better with Allah in reward and in hope.
فتنة الأهل والأولاد: The trial of family and children
الحذر مع العفو والصفح: Caution, together with pardon and forgiveness
حذّر الله من أن يصدّ الأزواج والأولاد عن: Allah warned lest spouses and children turn one away from His obedience, and at the same time commanded pardon, overlooking and forgiveness.
ادعوهم لآبائهم: Call them by their fathers' names
أمر الله أن يُنسب كل ولد إلى أبيه، وأبطل: Allah commanded that every child be attributed to his father and abolished attributing a child to anyone else, to preserve lineage and rights.
اليتيم في كنف الأسرة: The orphan in the care of the family
أذن الله بمخالطة اليتامى في المعيشة على: Allah permitted living together with orphans to set their affairs right and called them brothers; Allah knows the one who corrupts from the one who sets right.
وصايا لقمان: المراقبة والصلاة والصبر: Luqman's counsel: mindfulness, prayer and patience
علّم لقمان ابنه أن الله يأتي بمثقال حبة: Luqman taught his son that Allah brings forth even the weight of a mustard seed, and commanded him to pray, enjoin good, forbid evil and be patient.
وصية إبراهيم ويعقوب لأبنائهما: The counsel of Abraham and Jacob to their sons
فلا تموتن إلا وأنتم مسلمون: Do not die except as Muslims
وصّى إبراهيم بنيه وكذلك يعقوب بالثبات عل: Abraham counselled his sons, as did Jacob, to remain firm in Islam; at his death Jacob asked his sons: What will you worship after me?
أمر الله نبيه ﷺ أن يأمر أهله بالصلاة ويص: Allah commanded His Prophet ﷺ to enjoin prayer on his family and be patient in it, and guaranteed his provision.
وكان عند ربه مرضياً: And he was pleasing to his Lord
أثنى الله على إسماعيل عليه السلام بأنه ك: Allah praised Ishmael, peace be upon him, for enjoining prayer and zakat on his family; he was pleasing to his Lord.
ثلاث عورات لكم: Three times of privacy for you
أدّب الله الأطفال والخدم بالاستئذان في ث: Allah taught children and servants to ask permission at three times within the home; once children reach puberty they ask permission at all times.
إبراهيم وإسماعيل: البلاء والتسليم: Abraham and Ishmael: trial and submission
يا أبت افعل ما تؤمر: O my father, do as you are commanded
شاور إبراهيم ابنه في رؤياه، فأجاب الابن:: Abraham consulted his son about his dream, and the son replied: Do as you are commanded; you will find me, Allah willing, among the patient. Allah ransomed him with a great sacrifice.
أول جريمة بين أخوين: The first crime between two brothers
تقبّل الله قربان أحد ابني آدم ولم يتقبل: Allah accepted the offering of one of the two sons of Adam and not the other, who envied and killed him and then became regretful; a lesson about envy between brothers.
لا تقصص رؤياك على إخوتك: Do not relate your dream to your brothers
نهى يعقوب ابنه يوسف أن يقصّ رؤياه على إخ: Jacob forbade his son Joseph to relate his dream to his brothers, fearing their plotting; an example of a father's wisdom and care.
لما قدر يوسف عليه السلام على إخوته عفا ع: When Joseph, peace be upon him, had power over his brothers he forgave them, saying: No blame upon you today; Allah will forgive you. And the family was reunited.
اصطفى الله آدم ونوحاً وآل إبراهيم وآل عم: Allah chose Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham and the family of Imran above the worlds, descendants one from another in faith and righteousness.
موسى وأهله في الطريق: Moses and his family on the road
امكثوا إني آنست ناراً: Stay here; I have perceived a fire
سار موسى عليه السلام بأهله من مدين، فلما: Moses, peace be upon him, travelled with his family from Midian; when he perceived a fire he said to his family: Stay here; perhaps I will bring you news from it or a burning brand so that you may warm yourselves.
فأسر بأهلك بقطع من الليل: Travel with your family in a part of the night
أمر الله لوطاً عليه السلام أن يسري بأهله: Allah commanded Lot, peace be upon him, to travel with his family by night, except his wife; salvation is for those of the family who believe.
حكماً من أهله وحكماً من أهلها: An arbiter from his family and an arbiter from hers
إذا خيف الشقاق بين الزوجين بُعث حكمٌ من: If a rift between spouses is feared, an arbiter from the husband's family and one from the wife's are sent; if they intend reconciliation, Allah will bring about harmony between them.
إذا خافت امرأة من بعلها نشوزاً: If a woman fears aversion from her husband
إذا خافت المرأة من زوجها نشوزاً أو إعراض: If a woman fears aversion or desertion from her husband, there is no blame on them if they reconcile, and reconciliation is best.
لا تخرجوهن من بيوتهن: Do not turn them out of their homes
أمر الله أن يكون الطلاق في وقت تستقبل في: Allah commanded that divorce take place when the woman can begin her waiting period, and forbade turning a divorced woman out of her home during it; perhaps Allah will bring about a new situation.
ولا تنسوا الفضل بينكم: Do not forget kindness between you
أوصى الله الزوجين عند الطلاق قبل الدخول: Allah counselled spouses who separate before consummation to pardon and be generous, saying: "And do not forget kindness between you."
ولا تمسكوهن ضراراً: Do not retain them to harm them
نهى الله الأزواج عن إمساك المطلقات للإضر: Allah forbade husbands to retain divorced wives in order to harm them, declaring it wronging oneself and taking the verses of Allah in jest.
أن ينكحن أزواجهن: Do not prevent them from remarrying their husbands
نهى الله الأولياء أن يمنعوا المطلقة من ا: Allah forbade guardians to prevent a divorced woman from returning to her husband when they agree between themselves in a proper manner.
الأسرة الكبيرة: الأرحام والميراث: The wider family: kinship and inheritance
وتقطعوا أرحامكم: And sever your ties of kinship
قرن الله قطيعة الأرحام بالإفساد في الأرض: Allah coupled severing ties of kinship with spreading corruption on earth, and warned those who do so of His curse.
وبالوالدين إحساناً وبذي القربى: And to parents do good, and to relatives
أمر الله بعبادته وحده، ثم بالإحسان إلى ا: Allah commanded worship of Him alone, then kindness to parents, relatives, orphans, the needy and the neighbour.
يوصيكم الله في أولادكم: Allah instructs you concerning your children
تولّى الله قسمة الميراث بنفسه، وبيّن أنص: Allah Himself apportioned inheritance, set out the shares of children and parents, and said: "An obligation from Allah."
قل ما أنفقتم من خير فللوالدين والأقربين: Whatever good you spend is for parents and relatives
جعل الله الوالدين والأقربين أول من يُنفق: Allah made parents and relatives the first to be spent on, then orphans, the needy and the wayfarer.
البيت سكن: The home as a place of rest
والله جعل لكم من بيوتكم سكناً: Allah has made your homes a place of rest
امتنّ الله على الناس بأن جعل لهم من بيوت: Allah reminded people of His favour in making their homes a place of rest where they find peace; the home is the family's shelter and place of rest.
وعد الله المؤمنين أن يلحق بهم ذريتهم الم: Allah promised the believers to join their believing offspring with them in Paradise even if their deeds fell short, so the believing family is reunited in the abode of honour.

In some places the exegetes noted an advance and delay in the order of the words, not in the order of the meaning.

ومنه قوله «إني متوفيك ورافعك إليّ»، وقد: Among them is «I will take you and raise you to Myself»; exegetes differ on the meaning of the taking (wafat) and on the order within it.

مثال: «فلا أنساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلو: Example: «There will be no ties of kinship between them that Day, nor will they ask one another» with «And they will turn to one another, asking each other». It is explained that the Day of Resurrection has many stations: in some they do not ask one another and in others they do.

الوجوه: اللفظ المشترك الذي يُستعمل في مع: Wujuh (senses): a shared word used with several meanings according to context, such as the word «umma». Naza'ir (counterparts): words that denote one meaning. Books were written on this science, among them those of Muqatil ibn Sulayman and Ibn al-Jawzi.
معرفة الوجوه تعين المفسر على تحديد المعن: Knowing the senses helps the exegete determine the intended meaning in context, and the clues cannot be dispensed with.
من أمثلة لفظ «الأمة»: الجماعة من الناس،: Examples of the word «umma»: a group of people; the exemplary leader, as in «Abraham was a nation (umma), devoutly obedient to Allah»; the religion and way, as in «We found our fathers upon a way (umma)»; and a period of time, as in «to a limited period (umma)».
ليس لأحد أن يفسّر اللفظ بمعنى من معانيه: No one may interpret a word by one of its meanings without considering the context and the statements of the exegetes.
الإتقان للسيوطي، في فضائل القرآن وخواصه؛: Al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on the virtues and properties of the Quran; Fada'il al-Quran by Abu Ubayd al-Qasim ibn Sallam; al-Tibyan fi Adab Hamalat al-Quran by al-Nawawi.

للقرآن فضل عظيم على سائر الكلام، فهو كلا: The Quran has great merit over all other speech: it is Allah's word and the last and best of the Books, with guidance for creation and healing for the breasts. The texts speak of the merit of reciting, learning, teaching, memorizing and acting upon it, and of the standing of its people.
في صحيح البخاري عن عثمان رضي الله عنه أن: In Sahih al-Bukhari, from Uthman, may Allah be pleased with him, the Prophet ﷺ said: «The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.»
وفي صحيح مسلم أنه ﷺ قال: «اقرؤوا القرآن: In Sahih Muslim he ﷺ said: «Recite the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.»
وفي الصحيحين أنه ﷺ قال: «الماهر بالقرآن: In the two Sahihs he ﷺ said: «The one skilled in the Quran will be with the noble, righteous scribes (angels), and the one who recites it haltingly, finding it hard, will have two rewards.»

الوقف: قطع الصوت عن الكلمة زمناً يتنفس ف: Waqf (pausing) is cutting off the voice from a word for a time in which the reciter usually breathes, intending to resume. Ibtida' (starting) is beginning to recite after a cut or pause. This science helps in understanding the meaning and reciting correctly, and scholars made it one of the foundations of recitation.
أقسام الوقف عند كثير من المقرئين: تام يح: Types of pause according to many reciters: complete, where it is good to stop and to start with what follows; sufficient; good; and bad, where deliberately stopping is not allowed because it changes or spoils the meaning.
روت أم سلمة رضي الله عنها أن النبي ﷺ كان: Umm Salama, may Allah be pleased with her, narrated that the Prophet ﷺ used to pause his recitation verse by verse, so pausing at verse ends is a sunna according to a group of scholars.
في رواية حفص عن عاصم سكتات لطيفة دون تنف: In the narration of Hafs from Asim there are light silent pauses without breathing, among them in Surat al-Kahf «wa lam yaj'al lahu iwaja» and in Surat Ya-Sin «min marqadina».

للقرآن الكريم أسماء وأوصاف كثيرة جاءت في: The noble Quran has many names and descriptions in the Book of Allah, best known being al-Quran, al-Kitab, al-Furqan, al-Dhikr and al-Tanzil. Scholars took care to gather them and explain their meaning, as well as the names of the surahs and what is reported about them in hadiths and reports.
من أسمائه الواردة في التنزيل: القرآن «إن: Among its names given in the revelation: al-Quran «We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran», al-Kitab «That is the Book about which there is no doubt», al-Furqan «Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant», al-Dhikr «Indeed, We have sent down the Reminder, and indeed We will be its guardian», and al-Tanzil «And indeed, it is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds».
ومن أوصافه في الآيات: النور والهدى والشف: Among its descriptions in the verses: the light, the guidance, the healing, the mercy, the admonition and the spirit; each description shows an aspect of its merit and of its effect on hearts.
ورد في الأحاديث تسمية بعض السور، ومنه قو: Some surahs are named in the hadiths, including the saying of the Prophet ﷺ: «Recite the two radiant ones: al-Baqarah and the surah of Al Imran», narrated by Muslim.
وقد يكون للسورة الواحدة أكثر من اسم، فال: A single surah may have more than one name: al-Fatihah is called Umm al-Kitab and the Seven Oft-Repeated, and al-Tawbah is called Bara'ah.
البرهان للزركشي، في ذكر مناسبة الآيات وا: Al-Burhan by al-Zarkashi, on the correspondence of verses and surahs; al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on correspondences of verses and surahs; Nazm al-Durar by al-Biqa'i.

المناسبة: الارتباط والصلة بين آية وآية،: Correspondence is the link between one verse and another, one surah and another, or the opening of a surah and its close. This science reveals an aspect of the eloquence of the Quran's composition and the precision of its arrangement, and al-Zarkashi and al-Suyuti mention that Abu Bakr al-Naysaburi was among the first known for bringing it out.
من أنواعها: مناسبة الآية لما قبلها، ومنا: Its kinds include: the verse's relation to what precedes it, the opening of a surah to the end of the previous one, and the name of a surah to its purpose.
