الآية في السماء والأرض حين كانتا رتقاً ث: The verse on the heavens and the earth having been joined together and then parted, and what the exegetes said the joining and parting mean.
تدل الرصودات الفلكية (تباعد المجرات والإ: Astronomical observations (the receding of galaxies and the cosmic microwave background) indicate that the observable universe was, about 13.8 billion years ago, in an extremely dense and hot state and has been expanding and cooling since: the Big Bang model.
ربط الآية بنشأة الكون اجتهاد معاصر. فالم: Linking the verse to the origin of the universe is a contemporary reading. The reported view from Ibn Abbas is that the sky did not rain and the earth did not sprout (Ibn Kathir), and in al-Tabari from him too: "they were stuck together". Ibn Atiyyah called the rain-and-vegetation view "a good view", and al-Razi noted that the verse may refer to the possibility of joining and parting. So it is not asserted that the origin of the universe is meant.
الآية في استواء الله إلى السماء وهي دخان: The verse on Allah turning to the heaven while it was smoke, before completing it as seven heavens.
كان الكون المبكر غازاً حاراً مؤيَّناً أغ: The early universe was a hot ionised gas, mostly hydrogen and helium, from which stars and galaxies later formed under gravity; clouds of cosmic gas and dust (nebulae) remain the birthplaces of stars.
قال ابن كثير إن الدخان بخار الماء المتصا: Ibn Kathir said the smoke was the water vapour that rose when the earth was created, and al-Qurtubi relayed that it came from the "breathing" of the water, from Ibn Masud and others. Linking the smoke to the early gaseous state of the universe is a contemporary reading; the verse concerns the order of creating earth and heaven, on which the exegetes differed.
الآية في بناء السماء بقوة وأنه تعالى موس: The verse on building the heaven with might and Allah being its expander.
أثبتت رصودات هابل (#م) وقبله حسابات لومي: Hubble's observations (1929), and Lemaître's calculations before them (1927), showed that distant galaxies are receding and the universe is expanding; supernova measurements and the cosmic microwave background confirm it, and astronomers consider it settled.
فسّر المفسرون «لموسعون» بالقدرة (ابن عبا: The exegetes explained "musi'un" as ability (Ibn Abbas), as widening the reaches of the heaven and raising it (Ibn Kathir), or as widening provision; al-Razi said it comes from "capacity". The active-participle form can imply continuity in Arabic, which is the basis of the contemporary link to cosmic expansion: it is linguistically acceptable but is not the transmitted interpretation.
الآيات في أن الشمس والقمر وسائر الأجرام: The verses saying the sun, the moon and the other bodies each travel in an orbit by a fixed reckoning.
لكل جرم سماوي مدار: القمر حول الأرض، وال: Every celestial body has an orbit: the moon around the earth, the earth and planets around the sun, and the sun itself around the centre of the Milky Way in some 230 million years, all by exact calculation that lets eclipses be predicted years ahead.
المعنى هنا ظاهر عند المفسرين: لكل من الش: The meaning is plain to the exegetes: sun and moon each have an orbit and a path (Ibn Kathir), moving by a fixed reckoning that does not vary. As for what the "falak" itself is, the early scholars differed, as al-Razi mentions, so the verse does not commit to one account of it.
الآية في أن الشمس ضياء والقمر نور وأن ال: The verse saying the sun is a radiance and the moon a light, with the moon's phases set to count the years and reckon time.
الشمس نجم يُنتج الضوء والحرارة من الاندم: The sun is a star that makes light and heat by nuclear fusion in its core, while the moon is a rocky body that does not shine by itself and reflects about 12% of the sunlight falling on it; its phases come from its changing position relative to the sun and earth.
ذكر الرازي عن أبي علي الفارسي أن «الضياء: Al-Razi relayed from Abu Ali al-Farisi that "diya'" is the plural of "daw'" or a verbal noun, and took the sun's having its radiance and the moon its light as proof of One who assigned and measured them. The scientific distinction between a source of light and a reflector is a contemporary reading with no text from the exegetes, and the Quran describes the moon as both "light" and "luminous", so it is not asserted that the two words are meant to distinguish.
السماء سقفاً محفوظاً: The heaven as a protected roof
The verse on making the heaven a protected roof.
يحمي الغلاف الجوي للأرض ومجالها المغناطي: The earth's atmosphere and magnetic field shield its surface from most meteors (which burn up by friction), from harmful ultraviolet radiation absorbed by the ozone layer, and from many solar-wind particles.
نقل القرطبي أن «محفوظاً» أي من أن يقع وي: Al-Qurtubi relayed that "protected" means from falling onto the earth, or, by the stars, from the devils, or from demolition and breakage. Linking it to the atmosphere is a contemporary reading that joins the verse's plain sense to the idea of protection; it is not part of the transmitted interpretation.
تكوير الليل على النهار: The night wrapped over the day
الآية في تكوير الليل على النهار والنهار: The verse on Allah wrapping the night over the day and the day over the night.
تدور الأرض، وهي شبه كروية، حول محورها في: The earth, roughly spherical, rotates on its axis, so night and day succeed one another gradually at each place through dawn and dusk; each passes into the other rather than switching abruptly.
التكوير في اللغة طرح الشيء بعضه على بعض: In Arabic "takwir" is throwing a thing over itself in layers, like winding a turban (al-Qurtubi); al-Dahhak said it means throwing this over that, and al-Sa'di explained it as bringing each into the place of the other. The transmitted meaning is the succession of night and day. Deriving the earth's sphericity from the word is a linguistic possibility, not asserted; the earth's shape is established in science independently of this verse.
«والشمس تجري لمستقر لها»: "The sun runs to a resting place"
The verse saying the sun runs to a resting place that belongs to it.
تدور الشمس حول مركز المجرة بسرعة نحو # ك: The sun orbits the galactic centre at roughly 220 km/s and moves relative to nearby stars; it is a middle-aged star with about five billion years of fuel left.
ذكر ابن كثير في «لمستقر لها» قولين: المس: Ibn Kathir gave two views on "to a resting place": its spatial resting place beneath the Throne, and the end of its course, meaning its highest and lowest points; al-Qurtubi relayed the hadith of Abu Dharr about its prostration beneath the Throne, which is a report of the unseen not to be mapped onto a known astronomical motion. This is a contested matter, and linking the verse to the sun's motion in the galaxy is not asserted.
الآية في إنزال الحديد وفيه بأس شديد ومنا: The verse on Allah sending down iron, in which is great might and benefits for people.
يتكوّن الحديد بتفاعلات الاندماج النووي ف: Iron is made by nuclear fusion in the cores of massive stars and in supernova explosions, which scatter it through space where planets form from it; so the earth's iron was made in stars, not on earth.
فسّر الطبري والسعدي «أنزلنا الحديد» بما: Al-Tabari and al-Sa'di explained "We sent down iron" by its great might and benefits for people, and gave no cosmic origin. The verb "anzala" is also used in the Quran for livestock ("He sent down for you eight pairs of livestock"), meaning bringing into being and providing, so a cosmic descent is not asserted.
الآيات في جعل الجبال أوتاداً ورواسي للأر: The verses on making the mountains pegs and firm anchors for the earth.
للجبال جذور من صخور أخف تمتد في قشرة الأ: Mountains have roots of lighter rock extending into the crust far deeper than their height above the surface (the principle of isostasy, Airy 1855), and mostly arise from the collision of tectonic plates.
قال ابن كثير والقرطبي إنها أوتاد تثبّت ا: Ibn Kathir and al-Qurtubi said they are pegs that steady the earth so it does not shake with its people. Geologists do not hold that mountains are what prevents earthquakes, so linking "pegs" to mountain roots is an interpretive suggestion that is not asserted, though it does not contradict the transmitted meaning.
الآيات في غلبة الروم في أدنى الأرض ثم ظه: The verses on the Romans being defeated in the nearest land and then prevailing.
أخفض يابسة على سطح الأرض هي شاطئ البحر ا: The lowest dry land on earth is the shore of the Dead Sea, more than 420 metres below sea level.
قال القرطبي وابن عطية إن «أدنى» بمعنى أق: Al-Qurtubi and Ibn Atiyyah said "adna" means nearest and that the battle was at Adhri'at and Busra (Ikrimah), which is nearest relative to Makkah, or in the Jazirah (Mujahid) or Jordan (Muqatil). The location is disputed, and it is not asserted that "adna" here means "lowest".
اهتزاز الأرض وربوها بالماء: The earth stirring and swelling with rain
الآيتان في الأرض الهامدة إذا نزل عليها ا: The two verses on the barren earth that stirs, swells and brings forth growth when water comes down on it.
إذا نزل المطر على تربة جافة هامدة تشرّبت: When rain falls on dry barren soil, clay particles take up water, swell and expand, so the soil surface rises and its grains move, and then seeds sprout and plants of many kinds grow.
فسّر القرطبي «اهتزت» بتحركت، وقال الطبري: Al-Qurtubi explained "ihtazzat" as "moved"; al-Tabari and al-Sa'di said it moved with growth and "rabat" means rose and its vegetation increased. The transmitted meaning is movement and rising; linking it to soil swelling is a well-known contemporary reading.
الماء يُسلك ينابيع في الأرض: Water sent down and made to flow as springs
الآيتان في إنزال الماء من السماء وسلكه ي: The two verses on water sent down from the sky and made to travel as springs in the earth.
المياه الجوفية والينابيع تتغذى في معظمها: Groundwater and springs are fed mostly by rain and snowmelt seeping into the ground; hydrology holds that the water cycle is their source, as scientists showed from the seventeenth century (Pierre Perrault, 1674).
قال ابن كثير: أصل الماء في الأرض من السم: Ibn Kathir said the origin of the water in the earth is from the sky, which Allah then sends through parts of the earth and makes spring up as sources. Al-Sa'di said He placed in it a spring that is drawn easily. The transmitted meaning agrees with science, though the tradition says nothing of the water cycle's details.
الآيات في مرج البحرين: عذبٍ وملحٍ، وجعل: The verses on Allah letting two seas flow side by side, one sweet and one salty, with a barrier between them.
عند التقاء مياه مختلفة في الملوحة والكثا: Where waters of different salinity and density meet (a river entering the sea, or Mediterranean and Atlantic water at the Strait of Gibraltar) a thin transition zone forms that keeps each mass distinct over long distances, while mixing slowly across it.
فسّر ابن كثير والسعدي البرزخ بحاجز من ال: Ibn Kathir and al-Sa'di explained the barrier as a strip of land between sweet and salty water, and al-Qurtubi relayed from al-Dahhak that it is what lies between sky and earth. The transmitted view differs from the watery boundary oceanography describes, and it cannot be said that the two waters never mix at all, since oceanography shows gradual mixing.
ظلمات البحر اللجي والموج: Darkness upon darkness in the deep sea
الآية في ظلمات البحر اللجي وما يغشاه من: The verse on layered darkness in a deep sea, covered by wave upon wave and cloud.
يضعف الضوء مع العمق: يختفي الأحمر أولاً،: Light fades with depth: red vanishes first, little sunlight reaches below about 200 metres, and total darkness lies below about 1,000 metres; oceans also show internal waves at the boundaries between layers of different density below the surface, with surface waves above them.
عدّ السعدي الظلمات: ظلمة البحر ثم الأموا: Al-Sa'di enumerated the darknesses: the sea, then the waves, then the clouds, then the night; Ibn Kathir said it is a parable for the heart of the ignorant, imitating unbeliever. The verse is a parable in its context, and linking it to oceanography is a well-known contemporary reading; internal waves need not be what is meant.
السحاب: يزجيه الله ثم يؤلف بينه ثم يجعله: The clouds driven, joined and piled up
الآية في سَوق السحاب وتأليفه وجعله ركاما: The verse on Allah driving the clouds, joining them together and piling them up, and then the rain emerging from them.
تدفع الرياح سحباً صغيرة متفرقة فتتجمع وت: Winds push small scattered clouds that merge through convection currents and then pile up vertically into a huge cumulonimbus several kilometres tall, from which rain falls and from which hail may form.
فسّر السعدي «يزجي» بيسوق قطعاً متفرقة و«: Al-Sa'di explained "yuzji" as driving scattered pieces and "yu'allif" as joining the pieces into piled-up cloud like mountains, and al-Qurtubi said He gathers it so it grows strong, joined and dense. The transmitted meaning is plain and agrees with the meteorological description.
الآية في إرسال الرياح لواقح فينزل الماء: The verse on Allah sending the winds as fertilisers so water comes down from the sky.
تحمل الرياح حبوب اللقاح فتلقّح كثيراً من: Winds carry pollen and fertilise many plants (such as palms, conifers and grasses), and also help move water vapour and gather clouds so rain falls.
نصّ ابن كثير على معنيين: تلقيح السحاب وت: Ibn Kathir gave two meanings: fertilising the clouds and fertilising the trees; al-Qurtubi said "lawaqih" are carriers of water, dust and cloud, and al-Tabari held that they are both conceiving and fertilising. These are early views that agree with what botany and meteorology establish, so the meaning is clear.
المطر بقدر والسماء ذات الرجع: Rain by measure and the sky that returns
الآيات في إنزال الماء بقدر وفي السماء ذا: The verses on water sent down in due measure and on the sky that gives back.
الدورة المائية: يتبخر الماء من البحار وا: The water cycle: water evaporates from seas, soil and plants, condenses in the air and returns as rain or snow; annual precipitation on the earth is estimated at about half a million cubic kilometres, distributed over regions in proportions that keep the water balance.
قال ابن عباس في «الرجع»: المطر، «تمطر ثم: Ibn Abbas said of "raj'": rain, "it rains and rains again" (Ibn Kathir), which is also the lexicographers' view (al-Qurtubi); al-Qurtubi explained "bi-qadar" as a beneficial measure, which would destroy if it were more. The transmitted meaning is rain and its return, and the link to the water cycle is plain and consistent.
The verse on making every living thing from water.
كل الكائنات الحية المعروفة تحتاج إلى الم: All known living things need liquid water and are made mostly of it (about 60% of an adult human, more in many plants); biochemical reactions run in a watery medium, and no life without water is known.
قال ابن كثير: أصل كل الأحياء منه، وذكر ا: Ibn Kathir said the origin of all living things is from it, and al-Qurtubi mentioned the sense of every thing's life being preserved by water. "Every living thing" means the living, which is the nearest reading; no wider generality is asserted.
الآيات في خلق الإنسان من سلالة من طين ثم: The verses on man's creation from an extract of clay, then a drop, a clinging clot, a chewed lump, and bones clothed with flesh.
يصف علم الأجنة نشأة الإنسان من اتحاد الح: Embryology describes a person's origin from the union of sperm and egg, then implantation, with the embryo attaching to the uterine wall, then the appearance of early blocks (somites) in a small mass, then cartilage and bones forming and being surrounded by muscle, then the organs taking shape.
قرر السعدي وابن كثير ترتيب الأطوار: نطفة: Al-Sa'di and Ibn Kathir set out the order: a drop, a clot, a lump, bones, then bones clothed with flesh, and al-Tabari explained "formed and unformed". Some specialists note that bones and their muscles develop over overlapping periods, so the order is understood in general terms. As for the forty-day periods in the hadith, they are prophetic information accepted as given, with no scientific figures firmly mapped onto them.
The verse on creating man from a mixed drop.
يتكوّن الجنين من اتحاد خليتين جنسيتين: ح: The embryo forms from the union of two sex cells, a sperm from the man and an egg from the woman, whose genetic material combines (23 chromosomes from each, giving the embryo 46), forming the mixed zygote.
فسّر ابن عباس ومجاهد وعكرمة والحسن «أمشا: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Ikrimah and al-Hasan explained "amshaj" as the mixing of the man's fluid with the woman's (Ibn Kathir), and al-Qurtubi said "mixtures". The transmitted meaning is what genetics itself describes, so the meaning is clear.
الآية في خلقنا في بطون أمهاتنا خلقاً من: The verse on being created in our mothers' wombs, creation after creation, in three darknesses.
الجنين في الرحم محاط بثلاث طبقات واقية:: The fetus in the womb is surrounded by three protective layers: the abdominal wall, the uterine wall, and the fetal membranes (amnion and placenta) around it, none of which admits light.
فسّرها الطبري وابن كثير وغيرهما بظلمة ال: Al-Tabari, Ibn Kathir and others explained it as the darkness of the belly, the womb and the placenta, so the meaning is transmitted from them and agrees with anatomy.
The verses on Allah making for you hearing, sight and hearts.
يبدأ الجنين بالاستجابة للأصوات نحو الأسب: A fetus begins responding to sound around weeks 18 to 20 of pregnancy, while its eyes stay closed for a long time and sight becomes functional largely only after birth.
علّل الرازي ترتيب السمع قبل البصر بحكمة: Al-Razi explained the order of hearing before sight by the wisdom of learning: a person hears first, then sees, then understands with the heart. For him the order is rhetorical and educational, and linking it to the development of the senses in the fetus is a suggestion that is not asserted.
«من ماء دافق يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب»: "A gushing fluid from between the backbone and the ribs"
الآيات في خلق الإنسان من ماء دافق يخرج م: The verses on man being created from a gushing fluid that comes from between the backbone and the breastbone region.
تتكوّن الخصيتان والمبيضان في الجنين قرب: The testes and ovaries form in the fetus near the kidneys in the back region and then descend to their positions, which some researchers link to "from between the backbone and the ribs".
اختلف المفسرون في «الترائب» اختلافاً واس: The exegetes differed widely on "tara'ib": the place of the necklace on the chest, or between the breasts, or four ribs (al-Qurtubi and Ibn Kathir), and Ibn Kathir explained the verse as the man's backbone and the woman's chest. The embryological link is contested and not asserted.
ضيق الصدر عند الصعود في السماء: The chest tightening as one climbs
الآية في أن من يرد الله أن يضله يجعل صدر: The verse that whoever Allah wills to let go astray, He makes his chest tight and constricted as if he were climbing into the sky.
كلما ارتفع الإنسان عن مستوى البحر قلّ ال: As a person rises above sea level, air pressure and available oxygen fall, so breathing quickens and the chest tightens, producing altitude sickness, which can become severe above about 3,000 metres.
الآية تشبّه ضيق صدر من أُضلّ بمن يكلَّف: The verse likens the tight chest of the one led astray to one who is made to climb into the sky (al-Sa'di and al-Qurtubi), a figurative comparison in the context of guidance and misguidance. Pointing to the physiological fact is illustration, not interpretation.
الآيتان في قدرته تعالى على جمع العظام وت: The two verses on Allah's power to gather the bones and fashion the fingertips.
بصمات الأصابع فريدة عند كل إنسان بما في: Fingerprints are unique to each person, even identical twins, form in the fetus before birth and stay fixed for life, which is why they are used to establish identity.
فسّر ابن عباس وعامة المفسرين «بنانه» بأص: Ibn Abbas and most exegetes explained "bananah" as the fingers and toes: able to make them like a camel's hoof (al-Qurtubi and Ibn Kathir), in a context about resurrection. Linking it to fingerprints is a contemporary reading not asserted.
النحل: وحيها وبيوتها وشرابها: The bee, its homes and its honey
الآيتان في وحي الله إلى النحل أن تتخذ بي: The two verses on Allah's inspiration to the bee to take homes, eat of the fruits, and give a drink from its belly in which is healing.
العاملات في خلية النحل إناث عقيمات، وهنّ: Worker bees in a hive are sterile females; they forage for nectar and pollen and build the wax, while the males do not work in the hive; workers turn nectar into honey in their bodies with special enzymes.
جاءت الأفعال بالمؤنث (اتخذي، كلي، فاسلكي: The verbs are feminine (ittakhidhi, kuli, fasluki). Al-Qurtubi said "nahl" is feminine in the Hijazi dialect, so the feminine follows a grammatical rule and it is not asserted that the verse intends worker bees specifically. Ibn Kathir explained the inspiration as instinct and guidance, and al-Sa'di noted that honey has healing for people.
الآيات في أن الله خلق من كل شيء زوجين، و: The verses that Allah created pairs of everything, of what the earth grows, of themselves, and of what they do not know.
الزوجية ظاهرة في الأحياء: الذكر والأنثى: Pairing is evident in living things: male and female in animals, and many plants have male and female organs; in matter every particle has an antiparticle (the electron and the positron), and in electricity there are positive and negative charges.
فسّر ابن كثير «زوجين» بأزواج متقابلة: سم: Ibn Kathir explained "zawjayn" as opposing pairs: sky and earth, night and day, sun and moon, faith and disbelief, even animals and plants; al-Sa'di explained it as male and female among animals and, in the Ya-Sin verse, added "and what they do not know". The meaning is wider than biological pairing, and linking it to particle physics and the like is a suggestion.
معنى التقوى وحقيقتها وصفات المتقين وثمرا: What taqwa means, the qualities of the muttaqin, its fruits and its causes as the Quran explains them: the verses in Mushaf script and the exegetes' words verbatim, with an English meaning for each.
صفات المؤمنين بالتفصيل: الإيمان والعبادة: The qualities of the believer in detail: faith, worship, character and dealings.
السيرة النبوية من القرآن الكريم: The Prophet’s biography in the Noble Qur’an
أحداث السيرة النبوية ومحطاتها كما ورد في: The events and stations of the Prophet’s biography as they appear in the Noble Qur’an, from the first revelation to his passing ﷺ in chronological order, each event tied to the verses revealed about it, with the authentic hadiths in their wording and the commentators’ words.
تسلية النبي ﷺ: سورتا الضحى والشرح: Consoling the Prophet ﷺ: Surahs ad-Duha and ash-Sharh
اشتكى النبي ﷺ فلم يقم الليل ليلتين أو ثل: The Prophet ﷺ fell ill and did not pray at night for two or three nights, so a woman said to him: I hope your devil has left you. Surah ad-Duha was revealed to reassure him that his Lord had neither forsaken him nor hated him, and Surah ash-Sharh reminds him of Allah’s favours: opening his chest, lifting his burden and raising his mention.
والضحى والليل إذا سجى: By the morning brightness and the night when it grows still
قسم بالضحى والليل على أن الله ما تركه وم: An oath by the morning brightness and the night that your Lord has not forsaken you nor detested you.
ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضى: Your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied
وعد بأن آخرته خير من أولاه، وبعطاء يرضيه: A promise that the Hereafter is better for him than the present life, and of a giving that will please him.
ألم يجدك يتيما فآوى: Did He not find you an orphan and give you refuge
تذكير بنعم الله عليه: الإيواء والهداية و: A reminder of Allah’s favours on him: refuge, guidance and sufficiency.
ألم نشرح لك صدرك: Did We not expand for you your breast
The opening of the chest, the lifting of the burden and the raising of his mention.
حديث جندب في نزول الضحى: The hadith of Jundub on the revelation of ad-Duha
يروي جندب بن سفيان أن النبي ﷺ اشتكى فلم: Jundub ibn Sufyan reports that the Prophet ﷺ fell ill and did not rise for two or three nights; a woman said she hoped his devil had left him, so Allah revealed Surah ad-Duha.
عتاب «عبس وتولى» في ابن أم مكتوم: The gentle rebuke of «He frowned and turned away» about Ibn Umm Maktum
جاء رجل أعمى من المؤمنين هو ابن أم مكتوم: A blind believer, Ibn Umm Maktum, came to ask and learn from the Prophet ﷺ while a leader of the idolaters, whose guidance he hoped for, was with him. He turned from the blind man to the other, and the gentle rebuke of Surah ‘Abasa came down, making care for the sincere seeker a lasting principle, however weak or poor he may be.
عبس وتولى أن جاءه الأعمى: He frowned and turned away because the blind man came to him
عتاب لطيف: ما يدريك لعله يتزكى أو يتذكر: A gentle rebuke: what would let you know — perhaps he might be purified, or be reminded and the reminder would benefit him.
أما من استغنى فأنت له تصدى: As for he who thinks himself without need, you give him your attention
ليس عليه إلا البلاغ، والمقبل الخاشي أولى: He is responsible only for conveying the message, and the one who comes eagerly and fearing Allah deserves attention first.
حديث عائشة في نزول «عبس»: The hadith of ‘A’ishah on the revelation of ‘Abasa
تروي عائشة أن سورة عبس نزلت في ابن أم مك: ‘A’ishah reports that Surah ‘Abasa was revealed about the blind Ibn Umm Maktum when he came seeking guidance while a leader of the idolaters was with the Prophet ﷺ.
في العهد المكي، قبل الهجرة: In the Meccan period, before the emigration
طلب مشركو مكة من النبي ﷺ آية، فأراهم الل: The idolaters of Makkah asked the Prophet ﷺ for a sign, so Allah showed them the moon in two halves until they saw Hira between them, and he said: “Bear witness.” Yet they turned away and said: continuing magic — a warning that stubbornness is not cured by signs.
اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر: The Hour has come near and the moon has split
اقتراب الساعة، وآية انشقاق القمر، وإعراض: The approach of the Hour, the sign of the splitting of the moon and the denial of those who rejected it.
حديث ابن مسعود في انشقاق القمر: The hadith of Ibn Mas‘ud on the splitting of the moon
يخبر ابن مسعود أن القمر انشق في عهد النب: Ibn Mas‘ud reports that the moon split into two halves in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, who told those present to bear witness to the sign.
حديث أنس في انشقاق القمر: The hadith of Anas on the splitting of the moon
يروي أنس أن أهل مكة سألوا النبي ﷺ آية، ف: Anas reports that the people of Makkah asked the Prophet ﷺ for a sign and he showed them the moon in two halves until they saw Mount Hira between them.
استماع الجن للقرآن: The jinn listen to the Qur’an
في العهد المكي، ببطن نخلة قبل الهجرة: In the Meccan period, at Nakhlah, before the emigration
حيل بين الشياطين وبين خبر السماء وأُرسلت: The devils were barred from the news of heaven and shooting stars were sent at them, so they searched for the cause until they found the Prophet ﷺ leading his Companions in the dawn prayer at Nakhlah. They listened to the Qur’an, believed, and went back to their people as warners, and Allah revealed their story to His Prophet ﷺ.
قل أوحي إلي أنه استمع نفر من الجن: Say: it has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened
The account of the jinn and their belief in the Qur’an after hearing it.
وإذ صرفنا إليك نفرا من الجن يستمعون القر: And when We directed to you a group of the jinn, listening to the Qur’an
انصرافهم إلى النبي ﷺ واستماعهم وإنذارهم: How a group of jinn was directed to the Prophet ﷺ, listened, and warned their people.
حديث ابن عباس في استماع الجن: The hadith of Ibn ‘Abbas on the jinn listening
يروي ابن عباس أن الجن لما حيل بينهم وبين: Ibn ‘Abbas reports that when the jinn were barred from the news of heaven they searched for the cause, heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting in the dawn prayer at Nakhlah, believed, and their story came down in Surah al-Jinn.
حمراء الأسد: «حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل»: Hamra’ al-Asad: “Allah is sufficient for us and the best Disposer of affairs”
شوال، السنة الثالثة للهجرة، بعد أحد: Shawwal, year 3 after the emigration, after Uhud
بعد أحد خشي النبي ﷺ أن يرجع المشركون إلى: After Uhud the Prophet ﷺ feared that the idolaters would return to Madinah, so he called his Companions to pursue them, wounded as they were. They answered, reached Hamra’ al-Asad, and when they were frightened with the gathering of Quraysh they said: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. They returned with favour from Allah and no harm touched them.
الذين استجابوا لله والرسول من بعد ما أصا: Those who responded to Allah and the Messenger after injury had afflicted them
ثبات المؤمنين بعد الجراح، واستجابتهم، وق: The steadfastness of the believers after their wounds, their response, and their words: Allah is sufficient for us and the best Disposer of affairs.
حديث عائشة في الذين استجابوا: The hadith of ‘A’ishah on those who responded
تخبر عائشة أن النبي ﷺ لما انصرف المشركون: ‘A’ishah says that when the idolaters withdrew on the day of Uhud the Prophet ﷺ feared they would return, so seventy men, among them Abu Bakr and az-Zubayr, volunteered to pursue them.
حديث ابن عباس: حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل: The hadith of Ibn ‘Abbas: “Allah is sufficient for us”
يبيّن ابن عباس أن هذه الكلمة قالها إبراه: Ibn ‘Abbas explains that these words were said by Ibrahim, peace be upon him, when he was thrown into the fire, and by Muhammad ﷺ when he was frightened with the gatherings of the idolaters.
ذات الرقاع وصلاة الخوف: Dhat ar-Riqa‘ and the prayer of fear
اختُلف في وقتها: قبل الخندق عند جمهور أه: Its date is disputed: before the Trench according to most historians of the campaigns, after it according to al-Bukhari
في ذات الرقاع صلّى النبي ﷺ بأصحابه صلاة: At Dhat ar-Riqa‘ the Prophet ﷺ led his Companions in the prayer of fear while the enemy was near, and its manner came down in Surah an-Nisa’, establishing that congregational prayer is not dropped even on the battlefield.
وإذا كنت فيهم فأقمت لهم الصلاة: And when you are among them and lead them in prayer
صفة صلاة الخوف جماعة، تقوم طائفة معه وأخ: The manner of the prayer of fear in congregation: one group prays with him while another stands guard.
حديث صالح بن خوات في صلاة الخوف: The hadith of Salih ibn Khawwat on the prayer of fear
يصف الحديث صلاة الخوف يوم ذات الرقاع: طا: The hadith describes the prayer of fear on the day of Dhat ar-Riqa‘: one group prays a rak‘ah with him while another faces the enemy, then they exchange places.
إبطال التبني: زواجه ﷺ من زينب بنت جحش ون: Abolishing adoption: his marriage to Zaynab bint Jahsh and the revelation of the hijab
في المدينة بعد الهجرة، وفي سنة الزواج خل: In Madinah after the emigration; the year of the marriage is disputed among the biographers
كان زيد بن حارثة يُدعى زيد بن محمد حتى ن: Zayd ibn Harithah used to be called Zayd ibn Muhammad until the verse (Call them by their fathers) came down. Allah then willed to cancel the effects of adoption by deed as He had by word, so the Prophet ﷺ married Zaynab bint Jahsh after Zayd parted from her, “so that there will be no discomfort for the believers concerning the wives of their adopted sons”. The verse of the hijab came down at the wedding feast.
ادعوهم لآبائهم هو أقسط عند الله: Call them by their fathers; that is more just in the sight of Allah
The abolition of adoption and the attribution of children to their fathers.
فلما قضى زيد منها وطرا زوجناكها: So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you
الحكمة المعلنة: رفع الحرج عن المؤمنين في: The stated wisdom: removing discomfort from the believers concerning the wives of their adopted sons.
ما كان محمد أبا أحد من رجالكم: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men
ليس النبي ﷺ أبا لأحد من الرجال، بل رسول: The Prophet ﷺ is not the father of any of your men, but the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets.
يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تدخلوا بيوت النبي: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet
آداب دخول بيوت النبي ﷺ، ومنها الحجاب وسؤ: The manners of entering the Prophet’s houses, including the hijab and asking his wives from behind a screen.
حديث ابن عمر في نزول «ادعوهم لآبائهم»: The hadith of Ibn ‘Umar on the revelation of (Call them by their fathers)
يخبر ابن عمر أنهم كانوا يدعون زيداً زيد: Ibn ‘Umar reports that they used to call Zayd “Zayd ibn Muhammad” until the Qur’an came down ordering that adopted sons be named after their fathers.
حديث أنس في زواج زينب ونزول الحجاب: The hadith of Anas on the marriage of Zaynab and the hijab
يروي أنس أن النبي ﷺ أرسل زيداً يذكره لزي: Anas reports that the Prophet ﷺ sent Zayd to mention him to Zaynab after her waiting period, and she said she would do nothing until she consulted her Lord; the Qur’an then came down concerning her marriage.
حديث أنس في نزول آية الحجاب: The hadith of Anas on the revelation of the verse of the hijab
يروي أنس أن بعض الضيوف أطالوا الجلوس بعد: Anas reports that some guests stayed long after the wedding feast of Zaynab, and the verse of the hijab came down.
تخيير أزواج النبي ﷺ وآيات التحريم: Giving the Prophet’s wives a choice, and the verses on prohibition
في المدينة، دون تحديد سنة في الصحيح: In Madinah; the Sahih reports give no year
اجتمعت أمهات المؤمنين على طلب النفقة، فأ: The Mothers of the Believers pressed for more maintenance, so Allah commanded His Prophet ﷺ to give them the choice between the worldly life and its adornment, or Allah, His Messenger and the Hereafter, and they chose Allah and His Messenger. Allah then rebuked His Prophet ﷺ for making something lawful unlawful for himself to please some of his wives, and made that the occasion for the ruling on the expiation of oaths.
يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك إن كنتن تردن ال: O Prophet, say to your wives: if you should desire the worldly life
التخيير بين الدنيا وبين الله ورسوله والد: The choice between the worldly life and Allah, His Messenger and the Hereafter.
يا أيها النبي لم تحرم ما أحل الله لك: O Prophet, why do you prohibit what Allah has made lawful for you
عتاب لطيف مع المغفرة، وتشريع كفارة اليمي: A gentle rebuke together with forgiveness, and the ruling on the expiation of oaths.
حديث عائشة في التخيير: The hadith of ‘A’ishah on the choice
تروي عائشة أن النبي ﷺ بدأ بها حين أمر ال: ‘A’ishah reports that when Allah commanded that his wives be given the choice, the Prophet ﷺ began with her, and she chose Allah, His Messenger and the Hereafter.
حديث عائشة في شرب العسل: The hadith of ‘A’ishah on drinking honey
تروي عائشة قصة العسل عند زينب وما كان من: ‘A’ishah tells the story of the honey at Zaynab’s and her agreement with Hafsah, and the Prophet’s ﷺ statement that he would not return to it.
غزوة بني المصطلق (المريسيع) وقول المنافق: The campaign of Banu al-Mustaliq (al-Muraysi‘) and the words of the hypocrites
في السنة الخامسة أو السادسة للهجرة، وفي: In year 5 or 6 after the emigration; its year is disputed
في هذه الغزوة تبيّن نفاق عبد الله بن أبي: In this campaign the hypocrisy of ‘Abdullah ibn Ubayy was exposed when he said: “Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband”, and “If we return to Madinah, the more honourable will surely expel the meaner from it.” Surah al-Munafiqun came down to expose his words and to affirm that honour belongs to Allah, His Messenger and the believers.
هم الذين يقولون لا تنفقوا على من عند رسو: They are the ones who say: do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah
قول المنافقين، وبيان أن العزة لله ولرسول: The words of the hypocrites, and the declaration that honour belongs to Allah, His Messenger and the believers.
حديث زيد بن أرقم في نزول سورة المنافقين: The hadith of Zayd ibn Arqam on the revelation of Surah al-Munafiqun
يروي زيد بن أرقم أنه سمع كلام عبد الله ب: Zayd ibn Arqam reports that he heard the words of ‘Abdullah ibn Ubayy and conveyed them; the hypocrites denied them, then the surah came down and Allah confirmed his account.
حادثة الانفضاض إلى التجارة يوم الجمعة: The people leaving for the caravan on a Friday
بينما كان النبي ﷺ يخطب يوم الجمعة، قدمت: While the Prophet ﷺ was giving the Friday sermon, a caravan carrying food arrived, and most of those in the mosque left for it until only twelve men remained with him. The verse came down rebuking them and affirming that what is with Allah is better than amusement and than commerce.
إذا نودي للصلاة من يوم الجمعة فاسعوا إلى: When the call to prayer is made on Friday, proceed to the remembrance of Allah
الأمر بالسعي إلى الجمعة وترك البيع، ثم ا: The command to hasten to Friday prayer and leave trade, then to disperse in the land after the prayer.
وإذا رأوا تجارة أو لهوا انفضوا إليها: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion, they rushed to it
عتاب على الانصراف عن الخطبة، وبيان أن ما: A rebuke for leaving the sermon, and the statement that what is with Allah is better.
حديث جابر في الانفضاض إلى العير: The hadith of Jabir on leaving for the caravan
يروي جابر أن الناس لما أقبلت العير تركوا: Jabir reports that when the caravan arrived the people left the Prophet ﷺ standing on the pulpit until only twelve men remained with him.
قصة حاطب بن أبي بلتعة وسورة الممتحنة: The story of Hatib ibn Abi Balta‘ah and Surah al-Mumtahanah
رمضان، السنة الثامنة للهجرة، قبل فتح مكة: Ramadan, year 8 after the emigration, before the conquest of Makkah
كتب حاطب إلى قريش يخبرهم ببعض أمر النبي: Hatib wrote to Quraysh informing them of some of the Prophet’s ﷺ plans. Allah informed His Prophet and the letter was taken from the woman carrying it. The Prophet ﷺ excused Hatib for his sincerity and for having fought at Badr, and the opening of Surah al-Mumtahanah came down forbidding alliance with Allah’s enemies and recalling the creed of Ibrahim.
يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا عدوي وعدوك: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies
النهي عن موالاة أعداء الله، وتحذير من عد: The prohibition on allying with Allah’s enemies, and a warning about their enmity.
حديث علي في قصة حاطب: The hadith of ‘Ali on the story of Hatib
يروي علي أن النبي ﷺ أرسله مع الزبير والم: ‘Ali reports that the Prophet ﷺ sent him with az-Zubayr and al-Miqdad to take Hatib’s letter, then accepted Hatib’s excuse and recalled his participation at Badr.
مبايعة النساء: The pledge of allegiance of the women
بعد الحديبية وفتح مكة، من السنة السادسة: After al-Hudaybiyyah and the conquest of Makkah, between years 6 and 8 after the emigration
كان النبي ﷺ يمتحن المؤمنات المهاجرات بآي: The Prophet ﷺ used to test the believing women who emigrated by the verse of al-Mumtahanah. Whoever affirmed its conditions he told: “I have accepted your pledge”, without his hand ever touching the hand of a woman. The verse sets a pledge on monotheism, avoiding the major sins and obedience in what is right.
يا أيها النبي إذا جاءك المؤمنات يبايعنك: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you
شروط مبايعة النساء: التوحيد، وترك الكبائ: The conditions of the women’s pledge: monotheism, avoiding the major sins and obedience in what is right.
حديث عائشة في مبايعة النساء: The hadith of ‘A’ishah on the pledge of the women
تروي عائشة أن النبي ﷺ كان يمتحن المؤمنات: ‘A’ishah reports that the Prophet ﷺ tested the believing women with the verse of al-Mumtahanah and accepted their pledge verbally, without shaking hands.
براءة من المشركين: حجة أبي بكر: The declaration of release from the idolaters: the pilgrimage led by Abu Bakr
بعد تبوك أمّر النبي ﷺ أبا بكر على الحج ف: After Tabuk the Prophet ﷺ appointed Abu Bakr to lead the pilgrimage of year 9, then sent ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib after him to announce to the people on the day of sacrifice the opening verses of Surah Bara’ah: that no idolater may perform pilgrimage after this year and none may circle the House naked.
براءة من الله ورسوله إلى الذين عاهدتم من: A declaration of release from Allah and His Messenger to those with whom you made a treaty among the idolaters
إعلان البراءة، وإمهال المعاهدين أربعة أش: The declaration of release, the four-month respite for those under treaty and the announcement on the day of the greater pilgrimage.
حديث أبي هريرة في الأذان ببراءة: The hadith of Abu Hurayrah on announcing Bara’ah
يروي أبو هريرة أنهم أذّنوا يوم النحر بمن: Abu Hurayrah reports that they announced at Mina on the day of sacrifice that no idolater may perform pilgrimage after that year and none may circle the House naked, and that ‘Ali announced Bara’ah.
تعريف الرقية الشرعية وأدلتها من القرآن و: What lawful ruqyah is, and its evidence from the Quran and Sunnah
الرقية الشرعية قراءة أو دعاء أو ذكر يُقص: Lawful ruqyah is recitation, supplication or remembrance by which one seeks healing or protection from Allah, using the words of Allah, His names and attributes and the established supplications, with the belief that Allah alone is the Healer. This chapter explains its meaning, the evidence for its legitimacy from the Book and the Sunnah, and what falls outside it.
الرقية في الاستعمال الشرعي هي العُوذة وا: In the Shariah, ruqyah is the recitation and seeking of refuge by which healing from an illness or harm, such as a sting, the evil eye or fever, is sought, or protection from it before it occurs. It is "lawful" when three things are met: it is with the words of Allah, His names and attributes, or established supplications; it is in language whose meaning is understood; and the Raqi and the patient believe that it is only a means that has no effect by itself, and that benefit and harm are in Allah's hand.
الفرق بين مصطلحات الباب: Distinguishing the terms of this subject
أن يقرأ المرء على نفسه أو على غيره ما ثب: A person recites over himself or another what is authentically reported, or is lawful, of Quran and remembrances, seeking healing or protection.
The patient or his family asks another to recite over him. It is permitted, and leaving it out of reliance on Allah is better for whoever is able, as in the hadith of the seventy thousand.
خرزات وأوراق وحروز تُعلَّق لدفع الضر، وم: Beads, papers and charms hung to ward off harm, and what is made to win affection between spouses by magic. The text says they are shirk, so they are not part of lawful ruqyah.
الرقية لا تنافي الدواء، بل هما من هدي ال: Ruqyah does not oppose medicine; both are part of the Prophet's ﷺ guidance, and he commanded seeking treatment.
وصف الله القرآن بأنه شفاء ورحمة في ستة م: Allah described the Quran as healing and mercy in six places, commanded seeking refuge in Him from Satan in two great surahs, and made clear that Satan has whispering and a touch that is repelled by remembrance. The six verses of healing are detailed in the chapter "The Quran is healing", and the surahs used for ruqyah in the chapter "The surahs and verses used for ruqyah".
آيات الشفاء الست: الإسراء 82، يونس 57، ف: The six verses of healing: al-Isra' 82, Yunus 57, Fussilat 44, al-Tawbah 14, al-Nahl 69, al-Shu'ara' 80
الفاتحة والمعوذات وآية الكرسي وخواتيم ال: al-Fatihah, the two surahs of refuge, Ayat al-Kursi and the closing verses of al-Baqarah
ثبتت الرقية بالقرآن قولاً وفعلاً وإقرارا: Ruqyah with the Quran is established by the Prophet's word, deed and approval: he performed ruqyah over himself and his family, Jibril performed it for him, and he approved the Companion's ruqyah with al-Fatihah saying "How did you know it is a ruqyah?" and made taking a wage for it lawful. These are its principal proofs:
الرقية في السنة الصحيحة: الفاتحة، والمعو: Ruqyah in the authentic Sunnah: al-Fatihah, the surahs of refuge, Jibril's ruqyah, "Remove the harm" and placing the hand on the place of pain
الأصل الجامع قوله ﷺ: «اعرضوا عليّ رقاكم،: The comprehensive principle is his ﷺ saying: "Present your ruqyahs to me. There is no harm in ruqyah as long as it contains no shirk." Every ruqyah free of shirk, understood in meaning and with the belief that healing is from Allah, is permitted, and anything else is rejected. The conditions are detailed in the chapter "The conditions of lawful ruqyah".
تتنوع الرقية الشرعية بحسب ما يُرقى به (آ: Lawful ruqyah varies by what is used (Quranic verses, prophetic supplications, the beautiful names of Allah), by purpose (treatment or prevention) and by manner (recitation, light blowing, wiping and supplication). Each type here rests on an authentic text.
أولاً: الرقية بآيات القرآن وسوره: First: ruqyah with Quranic verses and surahs
أشهر ما رُقي به، وقد أقرّ النبي ﷺ الصحاب: The most renowned thing used for ruqyah; the Prophet ﷺ approved the Companion who recited it over the stung man.
المعوذات (الإخلاص والفلق والناس): The surahs of refuge (al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, al-Nas)
كان ﷺ إذا مرض نفث على نفسه بالمعوذات، وإ: When ill he would blow lightly on himself with the surahs of refuge, and when he went to bed he joined his palms, blew into them, recited them and wiped his body.
A protection from Satan for whoever recites it at bedtime.
من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر البقرة في ليلة كف: Whoever recites the last two verses of al-Baqarah in a night, they suffice him.
«بسم الله أرقيك من كل شيء يؤذيك»: "In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you from everything that harms you"
رقية جبريل للنبي ﷺ، وفيها طلب الشفاء من: Jibril's ruqyah for the Prophet ﷺ; it asks for healing from the evil of every soul and every envious eye.
دعاء كان النبي ﷺ يقوله للمريض، وفيه أن ا: A supplication the Prophet ﷺ used to say over the sick; it affirms that Allah is the Healer and there is no healing except His.
يقول المريض: بسم الله ثلاثاً، ثم يقول سب: The patient says "In the name of Allah" three times, then seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.
«أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشف: "I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you"
Said by the visitor of the sick seven times.
«أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة»: "I seek refuge for you with the perfect words of Allah"
تعويذة الأولاد من كل شيطان وهامة وعين لا: The seeking of refuge for children from every devil, every harmful creature and every evil eye.
ثالثاً: الرقية بأسماء الله وصفاته: Third: ruqyah with the names and attributes of Allah
أمر الله بدعائه بأسمائه الحسنى، فيُرقى ب: Allah commanded calling on Him by His beautiful names, so ruqyah is made with them, as in "In the name of Allah", "I seek refuge in Allah's might and power", "I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah" and "May Allah heal you"; this is a form of approaching Him through His names and attributes. Letters with no meaning that are not understood are not part of it.
الأسماء الحسنى وسيلة للدعاء، فيُختار منه: The beautiful names are a means of supplication; one chooses what suits the request: al-Shafi (the Healer) for healing and al-Hafiz (the Guardian) for protection.
قل ادعوا الله أو ادعوا الرحمن أيا ما تدع: Say: invoke Allah or invoke the Most Merciful; whichever you invoke, to Him belong the best names
الدعاء بأي اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى جائز: Supplication with any of Allah's beautiful names is permitted; this section keeps to what is established by an authentic text.
أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم: The beautiful names of Allah in the Quran
رابعاً: أنواع الرقية بحسب الغرض: Fourth: types of ruqyah by purpose
تُقرأ على المريض بعد وقوع المرض أو الأذى: Recited over the patient after an illness or harm occurs, like al-Fatihah over the stung man. It does not replace the doctor.
يُرقى من أصابته العين بالمعوذات وما ثبت،: One afflicted by the evil eye is treated with the surahs of refuge and what is established, and it was permitted.
تُقرأ قبل وقوع الأذى: أذكار الصباح والمس: Recited before harm occurs: morning, evening and bedtime remembrances. Detailed in the chapter on how to protect oneself.
يُرقى المسحور بآيات إبطال السحر وآيات ال: The bewitched is treated with the verses that undo magic and the verses of seeking refuge, with constant remembrances and returning to Allah. No attributed text fixes particular verses, so one keeps to the Quran generally.
خامساً: أنواع الرقية بحسب الهيئة: Fifth: types of ruqyah by manner
القراءة مع النفث والمسح: Recitation with light blowing and wiping
ينفث القارئ نفثاً خفيفاً مع شيء يسير من: The reciter blows lightly with a little saliva and wipes with his hand on the place of pain or the body. He ﷺ did this with the surahs of refuge.
ثبت في رقية الفاتحة أنه جعل يتفل ويقرأ ا: In the ruqyah with al-Fatihah it is reported that he spat lightly while reciting al-Fatihah.
The Raqi places his hand on the place of pain and supplicates.
ولم أجد في الكتب الستة المضمّنة نصاً صحي: I did not find in the six books bundled here a sound attributed text for other manners, such as reciting over water or oil and then drinking or washing with it; scholars have differed on it, so one keeps to what is reported and asks the scholars about the rest.
أنواع المعالجين ومعايير التمييز بينهم: The kinds of healers and how to tell them apart
ليس كل من تصدى للرقية راقياً شرعياً. بين: Not everyone who takes up ruqyah is a lawful Raqi. Between the Muslim doctor and the disciplined lawful Raqi on one side, and the charlatan, soothsayer, magician and the one who seeks the help of the jinn on the other, there are ranks. This chapter describes each kind and its ruling with evidence, and sets clear criteria that protect the patient from fraud.
أولاً: أصناف من يتصدى للعلاج: First: the kinds of those who take up treatment
يعالج الأمراض العضوية والنفسية بالأسباب: He treats physical and psychological illnesses by material means, which is commanded. Ruqyah does not replace him nor delay going to him.
يرقي بالقرآن والأذكار الثابتة بلسان مفهو: He performs ruqyah with the Quran and established remembrances in understood language, believes that Allah is the Healer, knows his limits so he does not claim knowledge of the unseen nor harm the patient, and takes a moderate wage if he takes one.
يُنصح ويُترك إن أصرّ: To be advised, and left if he insists
يرقي بالقرآن لكنه يخطئ في الضوابط: يصرخ: He recites the Quran but errs in the rules: he shouts and beats the patient on the pretext of expelling the jinni, converses with the jinni and believes what he tells him, or hops among diagnoses without knowledge.
المتاجر بالرقية: The one who trades in ruqyah
يتخذها مهنة ابتزاز: يتهم كل مريض بالسحر: He makes it a racket: he accuses every patient of magic or possession, demands large sums, sells "oils", "waters", "charms" and treatment plans with no evidence, and makes the client dependent on him.
العراف والمنجم والكاهن: The fortune-teller, the astrologer and the soothsayer
يدّعون معرفة الغيب أو المفقود أو سبب الم: They claim to know the unseen, the lost, or the cause of illness through stars, lines, shells or spirits. The Shariah forbade going to them and believing them.
الساحر والمعالج بالسحر (النشرة بسحر): The magician and the one who treats with magic (nushrah by magic)
يحل سحراً بسحر أو يستعين بالشياطين بكتاب: He undoes magic with magic or seeks the devils' help through writings, talismans and sacrifices. There is a warning against magic and a prohibition of nushrah.
المستعين بالجن: The one who seeks the help of the jinn
يتخذ جنياً «خادماً» أو «مرافقاً» أو يعاه: He takes a jinni as a "servant" or "companion", or makes pacts with the jinn and then deceives people with it. The Quran showed that seeking refuge in the jinn only increased them in arrogance.
المعالج بالمحرمات: The one who treats with forbidden things
يعالج بمحرم كالخمر أو النجاسة أو الدم أو: He treats with something forbidden such as wine, impurity, blood, slaughter for other than Allah, or writing the Quran with impure matter.
ثانياً: علامات الراقي الشرعي وعلامات الد: Second: marks of the lawful Raqi and marks of the charlatan
يرقي بكلام الله وبالأذكار الثابتة: He recites the words of Allah and established remembrances
ويقرأ بصوت يسمعه المريض ويفهمه، ولا يستت: He recites aloud so that the patient hears and understands, and does not hide behind obscure speech.
يعتقد أن الشافي هو الله: He believes that Allah is the Healer
فلا يدّعي أنه يشفي بذاته ولا يضمن الشفاء: He does not claim to heal by himself nor guarantee healing nor promise certain results.
لا يدّعي علم الغيب: He does not claim knowledge of the unseen
فلا يخبرك بمن سحرك أو ماذا في بيتك أو ما: He does not tell you who bewitched you, what is in your house or what will befall you; knowledge of the unseen is Allah's.
لا يخلو بامرأة ولا يلمسها: He does not seclude himself with a woman nor touch her
He performs ruqyah for her in the presence of her mahram, protecting her modesty.
لا يضر المريض: He does not harm the patient
فلا ضرب ولا خنق ولا إهانة ولا إيذاء بدعو: No beating, choking, humiliating or hurting on the pretext of expelling the jinni.
أجره معتدل أو بلا أجر: His wage is moderate or nil
The Shariah permits a wage but not exploitation.

أسباب المس والسحر: The causes of possession and magic
المس والسحر موجودان بنص القرآن والسنة، ل: Possession and magic exist by the text of the Quran and Sunnah, but neither should be assumed in every case; many symptoms have medical or psychological causes. This chapter explains the reality of each with its evidence, and its causes from the side of the devils and from the side of the person, without exaggeration or denial.
المس هو تسلط الشيطان أو الجني على الإنسا: Possession is the devil or a jinni gaining sway over a person to harm him, and is expressed by "seizure" or "convulsion". The Quran mentioned it in the verse on usury, the Sunnah contains what indicates its occurrence, and the exegetes affirmed it. What is meant here is the category, not every individual case.
الذين يأكلون الربا لا يقومون إلا كما يقو: Those who consume usury do not stand except as stands one whom Satan has driven to madness by his touch
ذكر المس والتخبط في القرآن، واستدل بها ا: The Quran mentions the touch and the convulsion, and the scholars used it as proof that seizures can come from the jinn.
وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله: And if an evil whisper comes to you from Satan, seek refuge in Allah
علاج النزغ والطائف: الاستعاذة بالله والت: The remedy for the whisper and the passing touch: seeking refuge in Allah and remembering. This is the state of the God-fearing when something from Satan touches him.
لا يصح تحديد سبب بعينه لكل حالة. لكن الن: No single cause can be fixed for every case. But the texts point to general causes that open the door to Satan and to causes that protect from him. These are not certainties in every situation but points of caution:
الإعراض عن ذكر الله والقرآن: Turning away from the remembrance of Allah and the Quran
قال تعالى: {ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض ل: Allah says: "And whoever turns away from the remembrance of the Most Merciful, We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion." Heedlessness of the heart is an entrance for the devils.
المتقي إذا مسه طائف من الشيطان تذكر واست: The God-fearing, when a touch from Satan reaches him, remembers and seeks forgiveness, whereas the devils extend the one who persists in sins further into error.
الاستعانة بالجن وطلب خدمتهم: Seeking the jinn's help and their service
بيّن القرآن أن الاستعاذة بالجن زادتهم ره: The Quran showed that seeking refuge in the jinn only increased them in arrogance; this is a cause of their dominance and involves shirk.
ترك أذكار الدخول والخروج والطعام والخلاء: Neglecting the remembrances of entering, leaving, eating and the toilet
من ترك ذكر الله عند هذه المواضع أدرك الش: Whoever omits mentioning Allah in these places, Satan finds lodging and supper, and entering the toilet without seeking refuge is a place where refuge is required.
الغضب من مداخل الشيطان وعلاجه التعوذ بال: Anger is one of Satan's doors and its remedy is seeking refuge in Allah from him.
إيذاء الجن أو الاعتداء عليهم بلا إنذار: Hurting or attacking the jinn without warning
وفي السنة ما يبين أن للجن حقاً في الأمان: The Sunnah shows that the jinn have a right to safety, and aggression against them can lead to harm. So one should not hasten to kill snakes that dwell in houses.
العين حق قد تسبب أمراضاً وأذى، وتُعالَج: The evil eye is real and may cause illnesses and harm; it is treated with ruqyah and seeking refuge, and is not possession in itself.
السحر حقيقة ثابتة بالقرآن والسنة، وهو من: Magic is a reality established by the Quran and the Sunnah; it is among the destructive major sins, and it harms no one except by Allah's permission. The Prophet ﷺ was bewitched without any effect on revelation or delivery of the message, and Allah healed him.
واتبعوا ما تتلو الشياطين على ملك سليمان: And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Sulayman
ذكرت الآية السحر وتعليم الشياطين له، وأن: The verse mentions magic and the devils teaching it, that it is a means of separating spouses, and that it harms only by Allah's permission.
ومن شر النفاثات في العقد: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
استعاذة من السحر والحسد، وفيها دلالة على: Seeking refuge from magic and envy, which indicates that magic has a reality.
يخيل إليه من سحرهم أنها تسعى: It appeared to him from their magic that they were moving
سحر السحرة تخييل على الأعين، وكيدهم لا ي: The magicians' magic is an illusion on the eyes, and their scheme does not succeed.
ما جئتم به السحر إن الله سيبطله: What you have brought is magic; Allah will surely nullify it
بطلان السحر وأن الله لا يصلح عمل المفسدي: The falsehood of magic, and that Allah does not set right the work of the corrupters.
من جهة الساحر: الكفر وطاعة الشياطين: From the magician: disbelief and obeying devils
نصت الآية أن الشياطين كفروا يعلمون الناس: The verse states that the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic. The magician draws near to the devils through the shirk they love, and this is the root of magic.
سُحر النبي ﷺ بكيد من لبيد بن الأعصم، وأم: The Prophet ﷺ was bewitched through the scheme of Labid ibn al-A'sam, and we were commanded to seek refuge from the evil of the envier, which is among the causes of magic.
ومنه ما بيّنته الآية من التفريق بين المر: Including what the verse showed of separating a man from his wife, then the harm spreads to livelihoods and bodies.
اللجوء إلى السحرة والكهان لحل المشكلات: Turning to magicians and soothsayers to solve problems
سبب لتوسع الفساد وبيع الأوهام، وفيه وعيد: A cause for the spread of corruption and the selling of illusions, with a grave warning in the Sunnah.
من جهة المصاب: الغفلة عن الأذكار والتحصي: From the afflicted: neglecting remembrances and protection
ما أصاب أحداً من الأذى فهو بإذن الله وقد: Whatever harm befalls anyone is by Allah's permission and decree, and among the causes of weak protection is heedlessness of remembrance, as in the report in Abu Dawud of Aban ibn 'Uthman forgetting the remembrance on a day of anger and being struck with paralysis.
خامساً: الفرق بين العين والسحر والمس وال: Fifth: the difference between the evil eye, magic, possession, whispering and illness
أثر يقع بالنظر مع الإعجاب أو الحسد، علاج: An effect that occurs by a glance with admiration or envy; its remedy is ruqyah, seeking refuge and supplication for blessing.
عمل مادي أو قولي يستعين فيه الساحر بالشي: A material or verbal act in which the magician seeks the devils' help to harm by Allah's permission. Its remedy is lawful ruqyah, remembrance and returning to Allah.
ثابت ولا يُجزم به في كل حالة: Established, not to be assumed in every case
تسلط جني أو شيطان على إنسان. قد يختلط بأ: A jinni or devil gaining sway over a person. It may be mixed with physical or psychological symptoms, which must be distinguished.
خواطر يلقيها الشيطان في الصدر، وعلاجها ا: Thoughts Satan casts into the chest; its remedy is seeking refuge, disregarding them and remembrance.
سببه طبي أو نفسي ويُعالج بالطبيب مع الرق: Its cause is medical or psychological and it is treated by the doctor, along with ruqyah, supplication and patience. The Prophet ﷺ commanded seeking treatment.
نصيحة: إذا ظهرت أعراض كنوبات الإغماء أو: Advice: when symptoms such as fainting fits, seizures, hallucinations, severe anxiety or depression appear, start with the doctor, together with ruqyah and supplication. Do not accuse anyone of magic or envy without proof; the Prophet ﷺ said, when it was proposed that the magic be taken out: "Allah has healed me, and I disliked stirring up evil against the people over it."
كيفية التحصن من المس والسحر: How to protect oneself from possession and magic
الوقاية خير من العلاج. وأساس التحصين الت: Prevention is better than cure. The basis of protection is the oneness of Allah and reliance on Him, then the established remembrances in the morning, evening, at bedtime, on entering and leaving the house, with keeping up prayer and reciting the Quran and leaving sins. Everything here rests on an established text.

لا يضر أحداً شيء إلا بإذن الله. فمن عرف: Nothing harms anyone except by Allah's permission. Whoever knows this and relies on Allah has a reassured heart and loses his fear of magic and the jinn. Reliance does not mean leaving the means but using them while the heart clings to Allah.
Reliance together with God-fearing suffices a servant in his affairs.

لا يصيب أحداً شيء إلا بقدر الله، وعلى ال: Nothing befalls anyone except by Allah's decree, and upon Allah let the believers rely.
وليس بضارهم شيئا إلا بإذن الله: And it will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah
الأذى لا يقع إلا بإذن الله، فلا يُخاف غي: Harm does not occur except by Allah's permission, so no one else is feared.
ثانياً: أذكار الصباح والمساء: Second: the morning and evening remembrances
من أعظم ما يحفظ الإنسان من الشيطان وأذاه: Among the greatest means of protecting a person from Satan and his harm are the morning and evening remembrances. We gathered those with the clearest evidence for protection; for the full remembrances see the chapter "Morning and Evening Remembrances".

قراءتها ثلاثاً بعد جمع الكفين والنفث فيه: Recite them with the palms joined and blown into, three times, then wipe over the body.

الشيطان ينفر من البيت الذي تُقرأ فيه سور: Satan flees from the house in which Surat al-Baqarah is recited, and the last two verses protect a home for three nights.

So Satan is denied lodging and supper.
إغلاق الأبواب وذكر اسم الله عند المساء: Closing the doors and mentioning Allah's name at evening
And putting out the lamp and covering vessels.
صلاة النافلة وقراءة القرآن في البيت: Voluntary prayer and Quran recitation in the home
So the home is not made like a graveyard.
الأذان وإقامة الصلاة: The call to prayer and establishing prayer
فيفر منه الشيطان، والمحافظة على الجماعة: Satan flees from it, and keeping to congregation is among the means of protection.
خامساً: تحصين النفس عند الخروج والنزول و: Fifth: self-protection on leaving, stopping, anger and the toilet
«بسم الله توكلت على الله ولا حول ولا قوة: "In the name of Allah, I rely on Allah; there is no power or might but with Allah."
"I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created."
"I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed."
"O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils."
Seek refuge and spit lightly to the left three times.
من هدي النبي ﷺ تعويذ الأولاد بكلمات الله: It is part of the Prophet's ﷺ guidance to seek refuge for children with the perfect words of Allah from every devil, every harmful creature and every evil eye, and to keep them indoors at nightfall.
حديث «أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة» في باب: The hadith "I seek refuge for you with the perfect words of Allah" in the definition chapter
بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء، والإخل: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing harms; al-Ikhlas and the two surahs of refuge three times; I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah; the tahlil a hundred times.
الإخلاص والمعوذتان بالنفث والمسح، وآية ا: al-Ikhlas and the two surahs of refuge with blowing and wiping, Ayat al-Kursi, the closing verses of al-Baqarah.

The basmalah and reliance on Allah, and mentioning Allah on entering.
Closing the doors, mentioning Allah and keeping children in.
عند الغضب والخلاء والوسوسة: In anger, in the toilet and with whispering
Seeking refuge in Allah from Satan.
المحافظة على الصلوات والجماعة وقراءة الق: Keeping up the prayers and congregation, reciting the Quran and leaving sins.
ثامناً: ما لا يصح في التحصين: Eighth: what is not valid in protection
تعليقها لدفع الأذى أو الحسد شرك لا حماية: Hanging them to ward off harm or envy is shirk, not protection; he ﷺ said: "Ruqyas, amulets and love-charms are shirk."
للتحصين أو لحل مشكلة: محرّم ومن أسباب زي: For protection or to solve a problem: forbidden and a cause of increased affliction.
الاعتماد على الرقية وترك الطبيب: Relying on ruqyah and leaving the doctor
اصبر واحتسب، وارق نفسك بالأذكار والمعوذا: Be patient and seek reward; perform ruqyah on yourself with the remembrances and the surahs of refuge; see the doctor if the matter is physical or psychological; use a disciplined lawful Raqi when needed according to the criteria in the chapter "The kinds of healers"; and increase seeking forgiveness and supplication. In the story of the woman who suffered seizures, the reward of patience under affliction was Paradise.
«إن أحق ما أخذتم عليه أجراً كتاب الله»: "The most deserving thing for which you may take a wage is the Book of Allah"
أجاز النبي ﷺ أخذ الأجر على الرقية بالقرآ: The Prophet ﷺ permitted taking a wage for ruqyah with the Quran. This is the basis for the Raqi's fee being lawful, without extortion or exploiting the patient's need.
كان يتعوذ من الجان وعين الإنسان حتى نزلت: He used to seek refuge from the jinn and the human eye until the two surahs of refuge were revealed
أصل في أن المعوذتين أعظم ما يُتحصَّن به: A basis for the two surahs of refuge being the greatest protection from the jinn and the evil eye together; the Prophet ﷺ took to them and left everything else.
«أعوذ بكلمات الله التامة من كل شيطان وها: "I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every harmful creature"
تعويذة نبوية تُقال على الأولاد، وفيها ال: A prophetic seeking of refuge said over children: it seeks refuge from devils, from every harmful thing and from the evil eye.
دعاء للمريض عند زيارته، يُقال سبع مرات،: A supplication for the sick person when visiting him, said seven times; it is among the easiest forms of ruqyah for any visitor.
«من أتى عرافاً فسأله عن شيء لم تقبل له ص: "Whoever goes to a fortune-teller and asks him about anything, his prayer will not be accepted for forty nights"
سؤال العراف حرام ولو لم يصدقه، وفيه عقوب: Asking a fortune-teller is forbidden even without believing him, and the punishment shows how grave it is. The fortune-teller is one who claims to know the stolen, the lost and the like by guesswork or suggestion.
سؤال النبي ﷺ عن الكهان: «ليس بشيء»: The Prophet ﷺ asked about soothsayers: "They are nothing"
ما يصدق من كلام الكهان قطعة من استراق ال: What turns out true in a soothsayer's words is a snippet stolen by a jinni and mixed with a hundred lies, so their occasional accuracy must not deceive.
«من أتى كاهناً فصدقه بما يقول فقد كفر بم: "Whoever goes to a soothsayer and believes what he says has disbelieved in what was revealed to Muhammad"
تصديق الكاهن في ادعاء علم الغيب من أعظم: Believing a soothsayer's claim to know the unseen is among the gravest dangers, in light of the verse: "Say: none in the heavens and the earth knows the unseen except Allah."
«من اقتبس علماً من النجوم اقتبس شعبة من: "Whoever acquires a branch of knowledge of the stars has acquired a branch of magic"
ادّعاء الاستدلال بالنجوم على الغيب والحو: Claiming to infer the unseen and coming events from the stars (astrology) is a branch of magic, and is not the useful science of astronomy.
«اجتنبوا السبع الموبقات» وفيها السحر: "Avoid the seven destructive sins", among them magic
جعل النبي ﷺ السحر قرين الشرك في الموبقات: The Prophet ﷺ placed magic beside shirk among the destructive sins, which shows the danger of learning it, practising it, or going to those who practise it.
سحر النبي ﷺ وشفاؤه منه: The magic cast on the Prophet ﷺ and his healing from it
السحر وقع للنبي ﷺ في جسده دون أن يمس الو: Magic did afflict the Prophet ﷺ in his body without touching revelation or the delivery of the message, and Allah healed him, so its existence is not denied. It also shows that prophets are not shielded from bodily illness.
«إن الشيطان يجري من ابن آدم مجرى الدم»: "Satan flows in the son of Adam like blood"
يدل على قدرة الشيطان على الوسوسة إلى الإ: It shows Satan's ability to whisper to a person and stay close to him, so one protects oneself with the remembrance of Allah, without widening suspicion of people.
المرأة التي كانت تُصرع فاختارت الصبر: The woman who suffered seizures and chose patience
الصرع المرض فيه أجر الصبر والجنة، وفيه ا: Seizures bring the reward of patience and Paradise, and one may ask Allah for wellbeing. The hadith does not mean abandoning treatment; it shows how great the reward of patience is.
الشيطان يدبر عند الأذان: Satan turns his back at the call to prayer
الأذان من أعظم ما يطرد الشياطين، والصلاة: The call to prayer is among the strongest things that drive devils away, and prayer in congregation and in the home is among the fortresses of protection.
«من نزل منزلاً فقال أعوذ بكلمات الله الت: "Whoever stops at a place and says: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created"
تحصين لمن نزل مكاناً في سفر أو نزهة، فلا: Protection for one who halts at a place, on a journey or an outing: nothing will harm him until he leaves it.
«بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء في الأ: "In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm"
ذكر صباحي ومسائي، يُقال ثلاث مرات، ومن ت: A morning and evening remembrance said three times; whoever forgets it should say it when he remembers.
«قل هو الله أحد والمعوذتين حين تمسي وحين: "Say: He is Allah the One, and the two surahs of refuge, in the evening and the morning three times; they will suffice you against everything"
ورد الصباح والمساء من الإخلاص والمعوذتين: The morning and evening portion: al-Ikhlas and the two surahs of refuge three times each; it is the basis of the Muslim's daily protection.
«كانت له حرزاً من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى ي: "It will be a protection for him from Satan on that day until evening"
ذكر التهليل مئة مرة في اليوم حرز من الشي: Saying the tahlil a hundred times in the day is protection from Satan for the one who says it, besides the great rewards it carries.
ذكر الله عند دخول البيت وعند الطعام: Mentioning Allah on entering the house and at mealtime
من ذكر الله عند دخول بيته وعند أكله حُرم: Whoever mentions Allah on entering his house and when eating, Satan is denied lodging and supper there; the home is protected by remembrance on entering.
«أغلقوا الأبواب واذكروا اسم الله» عند دخ: "Close the doors and mention the name of Allah" at nightfall
آداب للبيت عند المساء: كفّ الصبيان، وإغل: Evening etiquettes for the home: keeping children in, closing the door, covering vessels and putting out the lamp, with the name of Allah mentioned over all of it.
«بسم الله توكلت على الله ولا حول ولا قوة: "In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, there is no power or might but with Allah" on leaving the house
ذكر الخروج من البيت، وفيه هداية وكفاية و: The remembrance on leaving the house: it brings guidance, sufficiency and protection, and devils withdraw from the one who says it.

الغضب من مداخل الشيطان، وعلاجه التعوذ با: Anger is one of the doors of Satan and its remedy is seeking refuge in Allah from him; the angry person may not notice his state, so he should be reminded gently.

قاعدة تمنع إيذاء المريض بضرب أو خنق أو إ: A principle that forbids hurting the patient by beating, choking or humiliating him on the pretext of expelling a jinni; ruqyah is recitation and supplication, not violence.

أصل تتحصن به القلوب: السحر وغيره من الأس: A principle that fortifies hearts: magic and every other cause takes effect only by Allah's decree.
تقرير أن السحر له حقيقة، وأن العلاج منه: An affirmation that magic is real and that seeking refuge in Allah is the remedy.

Knowledge of the unseen is Allah's alone, so whoever claims it lies.
ذكر سحر النبي ﷺ، وأن الله أطلعه عليه وشف: The magic cast on the Prophet ﷺ, and that Allah informed him of it and healed him.

يمتد هذا الباب من عنوان «يا ليتني قدّمت: This chapter extends from the title "O that I had sent ahead for my life" in Surat al-Fajr to everything the Quran presents of generosity, giving and helping the needy. الآيات التي بيّنت ما يصون العطاء ويُتمّه: The verses that show what protects giving and completes it: leaving reproach and injury aside, sincerity for the sake of Allah, moderation between extravagance and miserliness, and kind words when giving is not possible.
أهل الحاجة وحقّهم في المال: Those in need and their right in wealth

نماذج الجود والإيثار: Models of generosity and preferring others
ما ذكره القرآن من صور الجود في الأخيار:: What the Quran relates of generosity in the righteous: the Ansar preferring others, the hospitality of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), Musa (peace be upon him) watering for the two women, spending with taqwa in Surat al-Layl, and following the example of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
ثمرة الجود وعاقبة البخل: The fruit of generosity and the end of miserliness
الآيات التي بيّنت ما يعود على المنفق من: The verses that show what returns to the one who spends: replacement, a trade that does not perish, purification of the soul, and the lasting trace of good after death; and in contrast what is said of miserliness, hoarding and withholding from the needy.
«يا ليتني قدّمت لحياتي»: Wishing to have sent ahead for one's true life
تمنّي الإنسان يوم القيامة أن لو قدّم لحي: The human being's wish on the Day of Resurrection to have sent ahead something for his true life.
«ولتنظر نفس ما قدّمت لغد»: Looking to what has been put forward for tomorrow
الأمر بالنظر فيما قُدِّم لغدٍ ومحاسبة ال: The command to consider what has been put forward for tomorrow and to hold oneself to account.
«لولا أخّرتني إلى أجل قريب فأصّدّق»: The dying person's plea to give charity
طلب المحتضر أن يؤخَّر ليتصدّق، وأمر المؤ: The plea of the dying to be given more time to give charity, and the command to believers to spend before death.

«أنفقوا مما رزقناكم من قبل أن يأتي يوم ل: Spend before a day without trade or friendship
الأمر بالإنفاق قبل يوم لا بيع فيه ولا خل: The command to spend before a day in which there is no trade, no close friendship and no intercession.
«كمثل حبة أنبتت سبع سنابل»: The grain that grows seven ears
مثل نماء النفقة في سبيل الله بالحبة التي: The parable of the growth of spending in the way of Allah through a grain that grows seven ears.

Charity given secretly and openly, by night and by day.
Describing the people of taqwa by their spending in ease and in hardship.
«ومن يوق شحّ نفسه فأولئك هم المفلحون»: Being guarded from the miserliness of the soul
الأمر بالإنفاق وبيان أن وقاية شحّ النفس: The command to spend and the statement that being guarded from the soul's miserliness is a cause of success.
«وأنفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه»: Spending from what you hold in trust
الأمر بالإنفاق مما جعل الله الناس مستخلَ: The command to spend from what Allah has made people stewards of, and the reward of those who spend.
Naming spending a goodly loan that Allah multiplies.
الإنفاق من طيّب الكسب وترك قصد الخبيث، و: Spending from good earnings and not aiming at the bad, and the two callers: the caller of the Most Merciful and the caller of Satan.
«لا تبطلوا صدقاتكم بالمنّ والأذى»: Charity spoiled by reproach and injury
إبطال الصدقة بالمنّ والأذى وضرب الأمثال: The spoiling of charity by reproach and injury, and the parables given about spending.
«إنما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزاء: Feeding for the sake of Allah alone
Feeding for the sake of Allah, seeking neither repayment nor thanks.
وصف عباد الرحمن في الإنفاق بين الإسراف و: The description of the servants of the Most Merciful in spending between extravagance and stinginess, and the prohibition of both a tied hand and a hand opened fully.
«قول معروف ومغفرة خير من صدقة يتبعها أذى: Kind words when giving is not possible

The categories of those to whom zakat is given.

الفقير الذي يمنعه التعفّف من السؤال وفضل: The poor person whose self-restraint keeps him from asking, and the merit of spending on him.
الإصلاح لليتامى ومخالطتهم، والوعيد في أك: Setting matters right for orphans and mixing with them, and the warning against consuming their property unjustly.
الأمر بإنكاح الأيامى وهم من لا زوج له، و: The command to help those without spouses to marry, with Allah's promise of enrichment. The exact word "widow" (armala) does not occur in the Quran; it occurs in the Sunnah.

وصف الأنصار بإيثار غيرهم على أنفسهم مع ا: Describing the Ansar as preferring others over themselves though in need.

إكرام إبراهيم عليه السلام ضيوفه بعجل سمي: The hospitality of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) with a fattened calf.
«لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أسوة حسنة»: جو: Following the example of the Messenger ﷺ
الأمر بالتأسّي برسول الله ﷺ في أقواله وأ: The command to follow the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his words, deeds and states.
موسى عليه السلام: «فسقى لهما ثم تولى إلى: Musa (peace be upon him) watering for the two women
سقي موسى عليه السلام للمرأتين دون طلب أج: Musa (peace be upon him) watering for the two women without seeking payment, then his supplication.
«فأما من أعطى واتقى وصدّق بالحسنى»: He who gives, fears Allah and affirms the best
وصف من أعطى واتقى وصدّق بالحسنى وتيسيره: The description of the one who gives, is mindful of Allah and affirms the best, and his being eased toward ease.

كتابة ما قدّمه الإنسان وآثاره التي تبقى: The recording of what a person sent ahead and the traces of his deeds that remain after his death.
Allah's promise to replace what is spent.
«يرجون تجارة لن تبور»: A trade that will not perish

The effacing of usury and the increase of charity.
أخذ الصدقة من أموال المؤمنين تطهيراً لهم: Taking charity from the believers' wealth as purification and growth for them.

قصة أصحاب الجنة الذين تواصوا بمنع المساك: The story of the owners of the garden who agreed to keep the needy away, and their garden was destroyed.

مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ وَمَا ز: Charity does not decrease wealth; and Allah increases a servant who forgives only in honor; and no one humbles himself for Allah but Allah raises him.

اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَة: Shield yourselves from the Fire, even with half a date.
مالك ما قدّمت ومال وارثك ما أخّرت: Your wealth is what you sent ahead

ليس لك من مالك إلا ما أكلت وما لبست وما: Of your wealth, only what you ate, wore and gave in charity

من تصدّق فأخفى صدقته: The one who gives charity and conceals it
سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِ: "Seven will be shaded by Allah, the Exalted, in His shade on the day when there is no shade but His: a just ruler; a youth who grew up in the worship of Allah; a man whose heart is attached to the mosques; two men who love each other for Allah, meeting for it and parting for it; a man whom a woman of rank and beauty invites and he says, 'I fear Allah'; a man who gives charity and conceals it so that his left hand does not know what his right hand spends; and a man who remembers Allah in solitude and his eyes overflow."

إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ: "When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge that is benefited from, or a righteous child who prays for him."
