ابدأ أسبوعك بصدقة ولو يسيرة، ولو بنصف تم: Begin your week with some charity, even a small one, even half a date.
خصّص مبلغاً ثابتاً من دخلك للأسبوع وسمّه: Set aside a fixed amount of your income for the week and call it "what I send ahead for my life".
انوِ ما تعطيه خالصاً لوجه الله، بلا انتظ: Intend what you give purely for the face of Allah, expecting neither thanks nor repayment.
أطعم محتاجاً أو شاركه وجبة، أو ادعُ ضيفا: Feed someone in need or share a meal with them, or invite a guest to your food.
فكّر في الجار القريب: هل في بيته حاجة تع: Think of your near neighbour: is there a need in his home that you know of?
Save a portion of today's food for someone who has none.
زُر قريباً أو صِل رحماً، وأعطِه ما يحتاج: Visit a relative and keep the tie, and give him what he needs if he is in need.
قل قولاً معروفاً لمن لا تستطيع إعطاءه ال: Speak a kind word to someone you cannot give to today, and excuse yourself gently.
اجعل لقريب أو صديق هدية صغيرة بلا مناسبة: Give a relative or friend a small gift for no occasion.
اسأل عن يتيم أو أرملة أو أسرة ضعيفة، وسا: Ask after an orphan, a widow or a weak family, and contribute to supporting or visiting them.
Help someone elderly or unable with a need of theirs.
احفظ مال يتيم أو أمانة لأحد ولا تفرّط في: Guard an orphan's property or someone's trust and do not neglect it.
أصلح بين متخاصمين، أو اقضِ حاجة لأحد من: Reconcile two people in dispute, or fulfil someone's need before he asks.
Forgive or give more time to someone in difficulty who owes you.
فرّج كربة: اتصل بمن علمتَ أنه في ضيق وسأ: Relieve a distress: call someone you know to be struggling and ask if he needs anything.
Give a secret charity that nobody knows of.
ساهم في مشروع خير جارٍ: وقف أو سقيا أو ع: Contribute to a lasting good project: an endowment, a water source or beneficial knowledge.
Plant a tree or sow a crop that people will benefit from.
أخرج صدقة الأسبوع قبل الصلاة، وادعُ للمح: Give the week's charity before the prayer, and pray for those in need.
راجع ما قدّمته هذا الأسبوع واكتب ما تنوي: Review what you sent ahead this week and write what you intend to increase.
احذر من شحّ النفس: أعطِ شيئاً أحبّ إليك: Beware of the soul's miserliness: give something dearer to you than usual.
كفالة اليتيم ورعاية الأرملة والضعيف في ا: Sponsoring the Orphan and Caring for the Widow and the Weak in the Quran and Sunnah
آيات اليتامى في حفظ مالهم ومخالطتهم وحسن: The verses on orphans — safeguarding their property, dealing with them, treating them well and honouring them — the verses on women whose husbands have died, and the verses on the weak and the oppressed, with authentic hadiths on the sponsor of the orphan, the one who strives for the widow and the needy, and mercy toward the weak.
يضم الباب آيات اليتامى وأحكام أموالهم، و: This section gathers the verses on orphans and their property, kindness to them and feeding them, the verses on the weak and the oppressed, the verses on women whose husbands have died (their waiting period, provision and inheritance), and hadiths from al-Bukhari and Muslim on sponsorship, striving for others and mercy. Note: the word "widow" (armala) does not occur in the Noble Quran; it occurs in the Sunnah. What the Quran offers are verses about women whose husbands have died, not that word. The phrase "the two weak ones" (the orphan and the woman) was not found in al-Bukhari or Muslim, so it is not included. What is treated elsewhere is referred to and not repeated: spending on orphans and consuming their property in "O that I had sent ahead for my life", and birr and kindness in "Birr in the Noble Quran".
آيات اليتيم والمستضعفين ومن فقد زوجها، م: Verses on orphans, the oppressed and women whose husbands have died, with hadiths on sponsoring the orphan, striving for the widow and the needy, and mercy toward the weak.
مال اليتيم وحفظه: The orphan's property and its safeguarding
الآيات التي تناولت مال اليتيم: إيتاؤه إي: The verses that address the orphan's property: handing it over at maturity, testing the orphan beforehand, guarding the wealth of those who cannot yet manage it, approaching it only in the best way, and standing up for orphans with justice.
الإحسان إلى اليتيم وإكرامه: Kindness to the orphan and honouring him
الآيات التي ذكرت اليتيم في سياق الإحسان: The verses that mention the orphan in the setting of kindness, feeding and shelter: doing good to him alongside parents and relatives, feeding him, his share in war gains and spoils, and the orphans in the story of al-Khidr and in the early life of the Prophet ﷺ.
لفظ «الأرملة» لم يرد في القرآن الكريم، و: The word "widow" (armala) does not occur in the Noble Quran; it occurs in the Sunnah. This chapter presents the verses that address women whose husbands have died: the waiting period, the bequest of provision for them, and their share of inheritance.
الآيات التي ذكرت الضعفاء والمستضعفين: ال: The verses that mention the weak and those deemed weak: weak offspring, the oppressed men, women and children, those made weak in the land, the excused weak, and the one who came striving despite his weakness.
الرحمة بالضعفاء ولين الجانب: Mercy towards the weak and gentleness
الآيات التي أمرت بالتواصي بالمرحمة وخفض: The verses that speak of enjoining one another to mercy and lowering one's wing to the believers, together with the hadiths on mercy, meeting needs and the mutual compassion of the believers.
الأمر بإيتاء اليتامى أموالهم والنهي عن ا: The command to give orphans their property and the prohibition of exchanging the bad for the good or consuming their wealth along with one's own.
«وابتلوا اليتامى حتى إذا بلغوا النكاح»: Testing orphans until they reach marriageable age
اختبار اليتامى حتى بلوغ النكاح، ودفع أمو: Testing orphans until they reach the age of marriage, and handing over their wealth once sound judgement is perceived.
«ولا تؤتوا السفهاء أموالكم التي جعل الله: Wealth of those who cannot yet manage it
النهي عن إيتاء السفهاء الأموال التي جعله: The prohibition of handing over to the immature the wealth that Allah made a means of support, with the command to provide for them from it and to speak kindly.
«ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن: Approaching the orphan's property only in the best way
النهي عن الاقتراب من مال اليتيم إلا بالت: The prohibition of approaching the orphan's property except in the best way until he reaches full maturity.
الأمر بالقيام لليتامى بالقسط، وذكر يتامى: The command to stand up for orphans with justice, and the mention of orphan girls and their dowers.
«وبالوالدين إحساناً وبذي القربى واليتامى: Kindness to orphans beside parents and relatives
عطف اليتامى على الوالدين وذوي القربى في: The mention of orphans together with parents and relatives in the command to do good.
وصف الأبرار بإطعام الطعام على حبه مسكينا: The description of the righteous as those who feed the needy, the orphan and the captive despite their love of the food.
«أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة يتيماً ذا مقرب: Feeding a related orphan in a day of hunger
ذكر إطعام اليتيم ذي القرابة في يوم المجا: The mention of feeding a related orphan on a day of hunger among the ways of attempting the steep path.
«وأما الجدار فكان لغلامين يتيمين في المد: The wall built for two orphan boys
قصة الجدار الذي أقامه الخضر لغلامين يتيم: The story of the wall al-Khidr rebuilt for two orphan boys whose father had been righteous.
«ألم يجدك يتيماً فآوى»: Reminding the Prophet ﷺ that Allah found him an orphan and sheltered him
تذكير النبي ﷺ بأن الله وجده يتيماً فآواه: The reminder to the Prophet ﷺ that Allah found him an orphan and gave him shelter.
«فلله وللرسول ولذي القربى واليتامى والمس: The orphans' share in war gains and spoils
جعل سهم لليتامى في خمس الغنيمة وفي الفيء: The share assigned to orphans in the fifth of war gains and in the spoils.
«والذين يتوفون منكم ويذرون أزواجاً يتربص: The waiting period of women whose husbands have died
بيان تربص من توفي عنهن أزواجهن أربعة أشه: The waiting period of four months and ten days for women whose husbands have died. The word "widow" does not occur in the Quran.
«وصية لأزواجهم متاعاً إلى الحول غير إخرا: Bequest of provision for the wives of the deceased
الوصية لأزواج المتوفين بالمتاع إلى الحول: The bequest to the wives of the deceased of provision for a year without being turned out.
«ولهن الربع مما تركتم»: نصيب من توفي عنه: The wife's share of her husband's estate
بيان نصيب الزوجة من تركة زوجها: الربع أو: The wife's share of her husband's estate: a quarter or an eighth.
أمر من يخشى على ذرية ضعاف بتقوى الله وال: The command to those who would fear for weak offspring left behind to fear Allah and speak with right words.
«والمستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدان»: The oppressed men, women and children
ذكر المستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدا: The mention of the oppressed men, women and children and their supplication for a protector and a helper.
«إلا المستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولد: Those excused for lack of means
استثناء المستضعفين الذين لا يستطيعون حيل: The exception made for the truly oppressed who can find no means and no way.
«ونريد أن نمنّ على الذين استضعفوا في الأ: Favour upon those made weak in the land
إرادة الله المنّة على الذين استُضعفوا في: Allah's will to favour those made weak in the land and to make them leaders and inheritors.
نفي الحرج عن الضعفاء والمرضى ومن لا يجدو: The removal of blame from the weak, the sick and those who find nothing to spend.
«أن جاءه الأعمى»: العناية بالضعيف الذي ي: The blind man who came seeking
سبب نزول سورة عبس: مجيء الأعمى الفقير يس: The occasion of the revelation of Surat Abasa: the coming of the blind poor man seeking to learn.
وصف المؤمنين بالتواصي بالصبر والتواصي با: The description of the believers as those who enjoin patience and enjoin mercy upon one another.
«واخفض جناحك للمؤمنين»: Lowering the wing to the believers
The command to the Prophet ﷺ to lower his wing to the believers.
أكل مال اليتيم من الموبقات: Consuming an orphan's property among the destructive sins
"Avoid the seven destructive sins." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, what are they?" He said: "Associating others with Allah, sorcery, killing the soul that Allah has forbidden except by right, consuming usury, consuming an orphan's property, turning back on the day of battle, and slandering chaste, unwary believing women."
وصية النبي ﷺ لأبي ذر في مال اليتيم: The Prophet's counsel to Abu Dharr about an orphan's property
يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنِّي أَرَاكَ ضَعِيفًا: "O Abu Dharr, I see that you are weak, and I love for you what I love for myself: do not take command over even two people, and do not take charge of the property of an orphan."
كَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ لَهُ أَوْ لِغَيْرِهِ: "The one who sponsors an orphan, whether for himself or for another, he and I will be like these two in Paradise." And Malik pointed with his index and middle fingers.
مدة الحداد على الزوج: The mourning period for a husband
لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّ: Umm Habiba said she heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three nights, except for a husband: for him she mourns four months and ten days."
السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِ: "The one who strives for the widow and the needy is like the fighter in the way of Allah — and I think he also said — like the one who stands in prayer without tiring and like the one who fasts without breaking his fast."
النصر والرزق بالضعفاء: Help and provision through the weak among you
هَلْ تُنْصَرُونَ وَتُرْزَقُونَ إِلاَّ بِ: Sa'd thought he had superiority over those below him, so the Prophet ﷺ said: "Are you given victory and provision except through your weak ones?"
أهل الجنة كل ضعيف متضعف: The people of Paradise: every weak one deemed weak
أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ك: "Shall I not tell you of the people of Paradise? Every weak one who is deemed weak; if he were to swear by Allah, He would fulfil it for him."
من لا يرحم لا يرحم: He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy
قَبَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وس: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed al-Hasan ibn Ali while al-Aqra' ibn Habis was sitting with him. Al-Aqra' said: "I have ten children and have never kissed any of them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ looked at him and then said: "He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy."
من كان في حاجة أخيه: Whoever is in the need of his brother
الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ، لاَ يَظْل: "A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not wrong him and does not abandon him. Whoever is in the need of his brother, Allah is in his need; whoever relieves a Muslim of a distress, Allah will relieve him of a distress of the Day of Resurrection; and whoever covers a Muslim, Allah will cover him on the Day of Resurrection."
تراحم المؤمنين كالجسد الواحد: The believers' mutual mercy is like one body
تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ و: "You see the believers in their mutual mercy, affection and compassion like the body: when one limb complains, the rest of the body responds with sleeplessness and fever."
الإنفاق وأهل الحاجة، ومنهم اليتامى والأي: Spending and generosity, including towards orphans and the unmarried.
قضاء حوائج الناس والإصلاح بينهم في القرآ: Meeting People's Needs and Reconciling Between Them in the Quran and Sunnah
آيات الإصلاح بين الناس والنجوى بالخير، و: The verses on reconciling between people and on private counsel in goodness, on enjoining what is right and helping the needy, on good intercession, and on kindness to the neighbour and the wayfarer, together with the Sahihayn hadiths on fulfilling a brother's need, relieving distress, concealing a Muslim's faults and Allah's aid to His servant.
حدود الباب: يجمع الآيات التي تأمر بالإصل: Scope: this section gathers the verses that command reconciliation between people, help the needy, intercede for them and show kindness to the neighbour and the wayfarer, with the words of al-Sa'di and Ibn Kathir verbatim and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim verbatim. The Quran uses the words for reconciliation, good intercession, Dhu al-Qarnayn's request for help and kindness to the neighbour; the exact phrase "fulfilling needs" does not occur in it, the meaning appearing in the verses of kindness and in the hadiths, and the phrase "relieving distress" comes from the hadith, not the Quran. The meaning of birr and its comprehensive verses belong to the Birr section, spending and charity to the Generosity section, and the rulings on marital discord to the Marriage and Divorce section.
الإصلاح بين الناس والنجوى بالخير والأمر: Reconciling between people, private counsel in goodness, enjoining the right, helping the needy, good intercession and kindness to the neighbour and wayfarer, with the verses, the commentators and the Sahihayn hadiths verbatim.
الآيات التي أمرت بالإصلاح وذكرت مواضعه:: The verses that command reconciliation and mention its settings: setting right what lies between people, the two believing parties that fight, the bond of faith, settlement between spouses and the two arbiters, pardon joined with reconciliation, and Shu'ayb's words "I only intend reform as far as I am able".
النجوى بالخير والأمر بالمعروف: Counsel in goodness and enjoining the right
الآيات التي استثنت من النجوى ما كان صدقة: The verses that except from private counsel what is charity, kindness or reconciliation, and that command calling to good, enjoining what is right, the mutual guardianship of the believers, good speech, repelling evil with good, and pardoning people.
إعانة المحتاج والشفاعة الحسنة: Helping the needy and good intercession
الآيات التي ذكرت الشفاعة الحسنة ونصيب صا: The verses that mention good intercession and its share, the request for help made to Dhu al-Qarnayn, the command to do good and kindness, and what Musa, peace be upon him, did for two women who could not water their flock.
الجار وابن السبيل والأخوة: The neighbour, the wayfarer and brotherhood
الآيات التي ذكرت الجار القريب والجار الج: The verses that mention the near neighbour, the distant neighbour and the wayfarer within the command of kindness, the believers' prayer for their brothers who preceded them, and Allah joining hearts after enmity.
«فاتقوا الله وأصلحوا ذات بينكم»: Fear Allah and set right what lies between you
الأمر بالتقوى وإصلاح ما بين الناس بعد ال: The command to fear Allah and set right what lies between people after the dispute over the spoils.
«وإن طائفتان من المؤمنين اقتتلوا فأصلحوا: Reconciling two believing parties that fight
الأمر بالإصلاح بين طائفتين من المؤمنين ا: The command to reconcile two believing parties that have fought, and that it be done with justice.
وصف المؤمنين بالأخوة وربط الإصلاح بين ال: Describing the believers as brothers and linking reconciliation between brothers with piety and mercy.
الصلح بين الزوجين إذا خافت المرأة نشوز ز: Settlement between spouses when the wife fears her husband's ill-treatment or turning away.
«فابعثوا حكماً من أهله وحكماً من أهلها»: Sending an arbiter from each family
بعث حكمين من أهل الزوجين عند خوف الشقاق: Sending an arbiter from the husband's family and one from the wife's when discord between them is feared.
ذكر العفو المقرون بالإصلاح وأجر العافي ع: Mentioning pardon joined with reconciliation, and that the one who pardons has his reward from Allah.
قول شعيب عليه السلام لقومه إن غايته الإص: Shu'ayb's words to his people, that his aim is only reform as far as he is able.
استثناء الصدقة والمعروف والإصلاح بين الن: Excepting charity, kindness and reconciliation between people from private counsel in which there is otherwise no good.
«ولتكن منكم أمة يدعون إلى الخير ويأمرون: A community that calls to good
الأمر بأن تكون من المؤمنين جماعة تدعو إل: The command that there be among the believers a community calling to good and enjoining what is right.
«والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض يأ: The believers are guardians of one another
وصف المؤمنين والمؤمنات بأن بعضهم أولياء: Describing believing men and women as guardians of one another who enjoin what is right.
الأمر بالقول الحسن للناس ضمن الإحسان إلي: The command to speak good to people as part of showing them kindness.
«ادفع بالتي هي أحسن» و«والعافين عن الناس: Repelling evil with what is better, and pardoning
الأمر بدفع السيئة بالتي هي أحسن، ووصف ال: The command to repel evil with what is better, and the description of the God-fearing as those who pardon people.
بيان أن من شفع شفاعة حسنة له نصيب منها و: That whoever intercedes with good intercession has a share of it and whoever intercedes with evil has a burden of it.
«فأعينوني بقوة أجعل بينكم وبينهم ردماً»:: Dhu al-Qarnayn asks them to help with strength
طلب قوم مستضعفين من ذي القرنين سداً يحمي: A people in need asking Dhu al-Qarnayn for a barrier to protect them, and his reply asking for their help with strength.
«وأحسن كما أحسن الله إليك»: Do good as Allah has done good to you
الأمر بالإحسان إلى الناس كما أحسن الله إ: The command to do good to people as Allah has done good to the servant, in the address of Qarun's people to him.
«وافعلوا الخير لعلكم تفلحون»: Do good that you may succeed
الأمر بفعل الخير عموماً وتعليق الفلاح عل: The command to do good in general and the linking of success with it.
موسى عليه السلام يسقي للمرأتين: «فسقى له: Musa waters for the two women
سقي موسى عليه السلام للمرأتين عند ماء مد: Musa's watering for the two women at the well of Madyan when he saw them standing back and waiting.
«والجار ذي القربى والجار الجنب»: The near neighbour and the distant neighbour
الأمر بالإحسان إلى الجار ذي القربى والجا: The command of kindness to the neighbour who is a relative and the neighbour who is not.
ذكر ابن السبيل في سياق الإحسان ومن يدخل: Mentioning the wayfarer within the command of kindness and who falls under the term.
دعاء المؤمنين اللاحقين لإخوانهم السابقين: The prayer of the later believers for their brothers who preceded them, asking that no rancour be left in their hearts.
تذكير الله المؤمنين بالتأليف بين قلوبهم: Allah reminding the believers of how He joined their hearts after enmity, and commanding them to hold fast to His rope.
ليس الكذاب من يصلح بين الناس: The one who reconciles between people is not a liar
لَيْسَ الْكَذَّابُ الَّذِي يُصْلِحُ بَيْ: "The one who reconciles between people, so that he conveys good or says good, is not a liar."
العدل بين اثنين وإعانة الرجل على دابته ص: Being fair between two people and helping a man with his mount are charity
كُلُّ سُلاَمَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَ: "Every joint of a person must perform charity every day the sun rises: to be fair between two people is charity; to help a man with his mount, lifting him onto it or lifting his belongings onto it, is charity; a good word is charity; every step taken toward prayer is charity; and removing harm from the road is charity."
انصر أخاك ظالماً أو مظلوماً: Help your brother, whether he is wrongdoer or wronged
انْصُرْ أَخَاكَ ظَالِمًا أَوْ مَظْلُومًا: "Help your brother, whether he is a wrongdoer or wronged." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, we help him when wronged, but how do we help him when he is a wrongdoer?" He said, "You take hold of his hands."
المسلم أخو المسلم لا يظلمه ولا يخذله: A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim; he does not wrong or forsake him
لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا وَلاَ: "Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices against one another, do not hate one another, do not turn your backs on one another, and do not undercut one another's sales, but be, servants of Allah, brothers. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not wrong him, forsake him or hold him in contempt. Piety is here" — and he pointed to his chest three times. "It is enough evil for a man to hold his Muslim brother in contempt. All of a Muslim is inviolable to another Muslim: his blood, his property and his honor."
من كان في حاجة أخيه كان الله في حاجته: Whoever is in his brother's need, Allah is in his need
تنفيس الكربة والله في عون العبد: Relieving distress, and Allah aids the servant
مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ: "Whoever relieves a believer of a distress of this world, Allah will relieve him of a distress of the Day of Resurrection; whoever eases the hardship of one in difficulty, Allah will ease things for him in this world and the next; whoever conceals a Muslim, Allah will conceal him in this world and the next; and Allah is in the aid of the servant as long as the servant is in the aid of his brother."
لاَ يَسْتُرُ عَبْدٌ عَبْدًا فِي الدُّنْي: "A servant does not conceal another servant in this world but that Allah will conceal him on the Day of Resurrection."
اشفعوا فلتؤجروا: Intercede and you will be rewarded
اشْفَعُوا فَلْتُؤْجَرُوا، وَلْيَقْضِ الل: When someone who asked or had a need came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, he would say: "Intercede and you will be rewarded, and let Allah decree through the tongue of His Messenger what He wills."
مثل المؤمنين في توادهم كالجسد الواحد: The believers in their mutual love are like one body
مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ و: "The likeness of the believers in their mutual love, mercy and compassion is that of the body: when one limb complains, the rest of the body responds with sleeplessness and fever."
الوصية بالجار: The counsel to treat the neighbour well
مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ: "Jibril kept counseling me about the neighbour until I thought he would make him an heir."
أكثر ماء المرق وتعاهد جيرانك: Add water to the broth and look after your neighbours
يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً: "O Abu Dharr, when you cook a broth, add plenty of water to it and look after your neighbours."
لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئاً: Do not belittle any act of kindness
لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئً: "Do not belittle any act of kindness, even if it is that you meet your brother with a cheerful face."
معنى البر وصوره: الآية الجامعة وبر الوال: The meaning and forms of birr, the comprehensive verse, kindness to parents, relatives, orphans and the needy, and cooperation in righteousness.
الجود والإنفاق والصدقة ومساعدة المحتاج و: Generosity, spending, charity, helping the needy, caring for orphans and the manners of giving.
آداب التعامل بين الناس: الصدق والوفاء وا: The ethics of dealing with people: truthfulness, fulfilling pledges, justice, reconciliation, pardon and the etiquette of neighbours.
الخطبة والعقد والمعاشرة والنشوز والشقاق: Engagement and contract, living together, marital discord, separation and what follows.
الصفات التي وصف الله بها المؤمنين: الإيم: The qualities with which Allah described the believers: faith, worship, character and conduct.
الوقف والصدقة الجارية: أثر الخير الباقي: Waqf and Ongoing Charity: The Lasting Trace of Good
ما يبقى للإنسان بعد موته من أعمال الخير:: What remains for a person after death of good deeds: ongoing charity and beneficial knowledge, waqf in the Sunnah and the practice of the Companions, and the verses on the lasting trace, spending in the way of Allah, and righteousness; with the verses in the Mushaf script, the words of al-Sa'di and Ibn Kathir verbatim, and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim in full.
حدود الباب: لفظ «الوقف» بعينه لم يرد في: Scope: the word "waqf" itself does not occur in the Noble Quran, so its rulings are not attributed to it. This section gathers the verses on lasting good deeds, the trace a deed leaves after its doer, spending, vows and the building of mosques, and presents in a separate theme the hadiths of the two Sahihs on waqf and the practice of the Companions. The hadith "When the son of Adam dies his deeds are cut off" and the verse "We record what they sent ahead and their traces" belong to the section "O that I had sent ahead for my life"; the detailed juristic rulings of waqf and the scholars' schools on it are outside this section.
ما يبقى للإنسان بعد موته من الخير: الصدق: What remains of good for a person after death: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and waqf in the Sunnah and the practice of the Companions, with verses, commentary and hadiths from the two Sahihs.
الآيات التي تفرّق بين ما يفنى وما يبقى:: The verses that distinguish what perishes from what remains: lasting good deeds, what is with Allah, what is sent ahead and found with Him, what benefits people and stays in the earth, a good remembrance among later generations, and the supplication of those who come later for those who went before.
الآيات التي تتناول العلم وبيانه وتعليمه: The verses on knowledge, making it clear, teaching it, its merit and the raising of its people, calling to Allah, and leadership in good that others follow, which are among the forms of trace that remain after one's passing.
الوقف في السنة وعمل الصحابة: Waqf in the Sunnah and the practice of the Companions
الآيات المتصلة بأحب المال وجهات الصرف وح: The verses connected with the most beloved wealth, the channels of spending, holding back arms and horses, building mosques, giving water to pilgrims and equipping the army of hardship, with the hadiths of the two Sahihs on the waqf of Umar (may Allah be pleased with him), the charity of Abu Talha, building mosques and digging the well of Rumah. The word "waqf" does not occur in the Quran; its meaning occurs in the Sunnah.
الإنفاق في سبيل الله وقرباته: Spending in the way of Allah and its acts of nearness
الآيات التي تجعل النفقة ابتغاء وجه الله،: The verses that make spending a seeking of the face of Allah, what is spent or vowed, and spending as acts of nearness with Allah.
«والباقيات الصالحات خير عند ربك ثواباً و: Lasting good deeds are better in reward and hope
وصف المال والبنين بزينة الحياة الدنيا، و: Describing wealth and children as the adornment of worldly life, and the lasting good deeds as better in reward and better in hope.
«ما عندكم ينفد وما عند الله باق»: What you have runs out and what is with Allah remains
بيان أن ما عند الناس ينفد وما عند الله ب: The statement that what people have runs out while what is with Allah remains, and the call to prefer what remains.
«وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الل: What you send ahead you will find with Allah
الأمر بالاشتغال بالقربات في الوقت الحاضر: The command to occupy the present with acts of nearness, with the promise that whatever good is sent ahead will be found with Allah.
«وأما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الأرض»: What benefits people stays in the earth
تشبيه الهدى بالماء، والباطل بالزبد الذاه: The likening of guidance to water and falsehood to vanishing foam, and the staying in the earth of what benefits people.
«واجعل لي لسان صدق في الآخرين»: A reputation of truth among later generations
دعاء إبراهيم عليه السلام بلسان صدق في ال: The supplication of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) for a reputation of truth among later generations, and the good remembrance that remained for prophets after them.
«والذين جاؤوا من بعدهم يقولون ربنا اغفر: The supplication of those who come later for those who preceded them
دعاء الذين جاؤوا من بعد المهاجرين والأنص: The supplication of those who came after the Emigrants and the Ansar for themselves and for those who preceded them in faith, and the supplication of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) for the believers.
«ليتفقهوا في الدين ولينذروا قومهم»: Gaining understanding of religion and warning one's people
الأمر بالتفقه في الدين وإنذار القوم، وبي: The call to gain understanding of the religion and to warn one's people, and the statement that the spread of knowledge is part of the scholar's reward.
«لتبيننه للناس ولا تكتمونه»: The covenant to make knowledge clear and not conceal it
الميثاق على أهل العلم ببيانه للناس وعدم: The covenant taken from people of knowledge to make it clear to people and not to conceal it.
«يرفع الله الذين آمنوا منكم والذين أوتوا: The raising of those given knowledge in ranks
رفع الله الذين أوتوا العلم درجات، وعدم ا: Allah's raising of those given knowledge in degrees, and the inequality of those who know and those who do not.
«ومن أحسن قولاً ممن دعا إلى الله»: The best of speech is calling to Allah
وصف الدعوة إلى الله بأحسن القول، والدعوة: The description of calling to Allah as the best of speech, and calling with wisdom and good instruction.
«واجعلنا للمتقين إماماً»: Leadership in good that others follow
دعاء عباد الرحمن بأن يجعلهم الله للمتقين: The supplication of the servants of the Most Merciful that Allah make them an example for the God-fearing, and the appointing of leaders who guide by His command.
«لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون» وأ: Spending from what one loves most
نزول الآية في الإنفاق مما يُحَبّ، وما فع: The revelation of the verse on spending from what one loves, and what the Companions did with their most beloved possessions.
تحبيس الأصل وصرف الثمرة في وجوه البر: Channels of spending named in the verse and in the waqf of Umar
ذكر الآية لمصارف الصدقات، وهي من جهات ال: The verse names the channels for obligatory charity, some of which (freeing necks, the way of Allah, the wayfarer) are also the channels to which Umar directed his waqf in the hadith. The verse concerns zakat, not waqf.
حبس الخيل والسلاح في سبيل الله: Holding back arms and horses in the way of Allah
الأمر بإعداد القوة ومن رباط الخيل، والأم: The command to prepare strength including tethered horses, the command to spend in the way of Allah, and, in the hadith, holding back arms and horses in the way of Allah.
«إنما يعمر مساجد الله من آمن بالله واليو: Those who maintain the mosques of Allah
وصف عُمّار مساجد الله، وبناء المساجد وما: The description of those who maintain Allah's mosques, and the hadiths on building mosques.
«أجعلتم سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد الحرام: Giving water to pilgrims and maintaining the Sacred Mosque
المقارنة بين سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد ا: The comparison between giving water to pilgrims and maintaining the Sacred Mosque and faith and striving in the way of Allah.
«ولا ينفقون نفقة صغيرة ولا كبيرة»: Every spending, small or large, is written down
كتابة النفقة الصغيرة والكبيرة للمجاهدين،: The recording of every spending, small or large, by those who set out, the case of those who found nothing to spend, and the equipping of the army of hardship and digging of Rumah in the hadith of Uthman (may Allah be pleased with him).
«وما تنفقون إلا ابتغاء وجه الله»: Spending is for oneself and for the face of Allah
كون النفقة لنفس المنفق وابتغاء وجه الله،: Spending as being for the spender's own self and for the sake of Allah, with its reward paid in full.
«وما أنفقتم من نفقة أو نذرتم من نذر فإن: Allah knows what is spent and what is vowed
علم الله بما يُنفَق وما يُنذَر، ونذر امر: Allah's knowledge of what is spent and what is vowed, and the vow of the wife of Imran of what was in her womb, dedicated to Allah.
«ألا إنها قربة لهم»: النفقة قربات عند ال: Spending as acts of nearness with Allah
وصف نفقة بعض الأعراب قربات عند الله وصلو: The description of the spending of some Bedouins as acts of nearness with Allah and of the Messenger's prayers.
وقف عمر رضي الله عنه أرضه بخيبر: Umar's waqf of his land in Khaybar
أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، أَصَابَ أ: Umar ibn al-Khattab acquired a piece of land in Khaybar, so he came to the Prophet ﷺ to seek his counsel about it. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have acquired land in Khaybar; I have never obtained wealth more precious to me than it. What do you command me to do with it?" He said, "If you wish, hold its principal and give its yield as charity." So Umar gave it in charity, on the condition that it not be sold, not be given away and not be inherited, and he gave it as charity for the poor, for relatives, for the freeing of slaves, in the way of Allah, for the wayfarer and for the guest. There is no blame on whoever manages it to eat from it in a fair manner and to feed a friend without seeking to accumulate wealth from it.
كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِي: Abu Talha was the wealthiest of the Ansar in Medina in palm groves, and the dearest of his properties to him was Bayruha', which faced the mosque; the Prophet ﷺ used to enter it and drink of its good water. Anas said: When "You will never attain righteousness until you spend from what you love" was revealed, Abu Talha stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah says, 'You will never attain righteousness until you spend from what you love,' and the dearest of my properties to me is Bayruha'. It is a charity for Allah; I hope for its goodness and its store with Allah. So place it wherever Allah shows you."
الصدقة عن الميت: Charity on behalf of the deceased
إِنَّ أُمِّي افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسَهَا، وَأُ: "My mother died suddenly, and I think that had she spoken she would have given charity. May I give charity on her behalf?" He said, "Yes, give charity on her behalf."
خالد بن الوليد واحتباس أدراعه: Khalid ibn al-Walid and his armor held in the way of Allah
وَأَمَّا خَالِدٌ فَإِنَّكُمْ تَظْلِمُونَ: As for Khalid, you wrong Khalid, for he has held back his armor and his equipment in the way of Allah.
من احتبس فرساً في سبيل الله: Whoever keeps a horse in the way of Allah
مَنِ احْتَبَسَ فَرَسًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّ: Whoever keeps a horse in the way of Allah, out of faith in Allah and belief in His promise, then its feed, its drink, its dung and its urine will be in his scale on the Day of Resurrection.
من بنى مسجداً يبتغي به وجه الله: Whoever builds a mosque seeking the face of Allah
مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا ـ قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ حَ: Whoever builds a mosque — Bukayr said: I think he said — seeking thereby the face of Allah, Allah will build for him the like of it in Paradise.
أرض المسجد النبوي وبنو النجار: The land of the Prophet's Mosque and Banu al-Najjar
يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي بِحَائ: "O Banu al-Najjar, name me a price for this garden of yours." They said, "No, by Allah, we ask its price only from Allah."
عثمان رضي الله عنه: رومة وجيش العسرة: Uthman (may Allah be pleased with him): Rumah and the army of hardship
أَلَسْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ الل: "Do you not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever digs Rumah, Paradise is his,' and I dug it? Do you not know that he said, 'Whoever equips the army of hardship, Paradise is his,' and I equipped them?"
مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ ا: Whoever calls to guidance will have a reward like the rewards of those who follow him, without that diminishing their rewards in the least.
من سنّ في الإسلام سنة حسنة: Whoever establishes a good practice in Islam
مَنْ سَنَّ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ سُنَّةً حَسَن: Whoever establishes a good practice in Islam has its reward and the reward of whoever acts by it after him, without any decrease in their rewards.
من يرد الله به خيراً يفقهه في الدين: Whoever Allah wants good for, He gives understanding of the religion
مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّ: If Allah wants good for someone, He gives him understanding of the religion.
بلّغوا عني ولو آية: Convey from me, even a single verse
بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً: Convey from me, even if it is a single verse.
الجود والإنفاق وأهل الحاجة، وآية «ونكتب: Generosity and spending, including the verse "We record what they sent ahead and their traces" and the hadith of ongoing charity.
نظرة القرآن إلى المال قيمةً وسلوكاً: كسب: The Quran's view of wealth: earning it, spending it, and the warning against hoarding.
نصاب الذهب والفضة والعروض والأنعام والزر: The nisab of gold, silver, trade goods, livestock and crops, and zakat al-fitr.
آيات الأحكام مبوّبة على أبواب الفقه، ومن: Verses of rulings arranged by chapters of fiqh, including transactions and inheritance.
إطعام الطعام وإكرام الضيف في القرآن والس: Feeding food and honouring the guest in the Quran and Sunnah
مواضع القرآن في إطعام المسكين واليتيم وا: The Quranic passages on feeding the poor, the orphan and the captive, urging others to feed the poor and the blame of those who leave it, the guests of Ibrahim and the stories of hospitality and its manners, the expiations and ransom tied to feeding, and fasting and the pre-dawn meal, with verses in the Mushaf script, the exegetes' words verbatim and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim.
حدود الباب: آيات الإطعام والحضّ عليه وال: Scope: verses on feeding, urging it, hospitality and the rulings of food connected with them. The Quran does not use the expression "honouring the guest" as such; it describes the guests of Ibrahim as "honoured" and relates how he hosted them, and the story of the guests of Lut. The hadiths on honouring the guest are taken from the two Sahihs only. The hadith "whoever gives a fasting person food to break his fast" is not in al-Bukhari or Muslim and so is not included; the chapter keeps to what the two Sahihs report on the merit of fasting, the pre-dawn meal and hastening the breaking of the fast. For spending in general and the hadiths of generosity see the chapter "O that I had sent ahead for my life", and for birr and relatives see the chapter on Birr.
آيات إطعام المسكين واليتيم والأسير والحض: Verses on feeding the poor, the orphan and the captive and urging it, the guests of Ibrahim and the manners of hospitality, expiations by feeding, fasting and the pre-dawn meal, with verses in the Mushaf script, the exegetes' words and the hadiths of the two Sahihs.
إطعام المسكين واليتيم والأسير: Feeding the poor, the orphan and the captive
الآيات التي ذكرت الإطعام في وصف الأبرار: The verses that mention feeding in describing the righteous and in climbing the steep path, show who is to be fed from spending, and say that Allah is the One who feeds and is not fed.
الحضّ على طعام المسكين وذمّ من تركه: Urging the feeding of the poor and the blame of leaving it
الآيات التي قرنت ترك الحضّ على طعام المس: The verses that joined leaving the urging of the feeding of the poor with denial and lack of faith, and listed it among the causes of punishment, as well as the owners of the garden who kept the poor out.
ما ورد في القرآن من قصص الضيافة: ضيف إبر: The stories of hospitality in the Quran: the guests of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), the guests of Lut (peace be upon him), the people of the town who refused to host, Yusuf (peace be upon him) and his good lodging, the wayfarer, and the manners of eating in homes and when invited.
الآيات التي جعلت الإطعام كفارةً أو فديةً: The verses that made feeding an expiation, a ransom or a share of the sacrificial animals: the expiation of oaths, the expiation of zihar, and eating from the sacrificial animals and feeding the needy.
آيات الصيام فيما يتصل بالطعام والشراب: ح: The verses of fasting in what concerns food and drink: the wisdom of fasting, the ransom of feeding in place of the fast, and eating and drinking until dawn.
وصف الأبرار بإطعام الطعام على حبه مسكينا: The description of the righteous as feeding the poor, the orphan and the captive despite their love for food, for the sake of Allah.
«أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة يتيماً ذا مقرب: Feeding on a day of hunger
بيان العقبة التي لم يقتحمها الإنسان، ومن: The explanation of the steep path that the human being did not climb, including feeding on a day of severe hunger.
الله المطعِم: «وهو يطعم ولا يطعم» و«ما أ: Allah feeds and is not fed
الله هو الذي يطعِم ولا يُطعَم، وهو الغني: Allah is the One who feeds and is not fed, and is free of need of the feeding of His creation.
«يسألونك ماذا ينفقون قل ما أنفقتم من خير: Who is to be spent upon
سؤال الناس عن النفقة وجوابه بذكر من تُصر: People's question about spending and the answer naming those to whom it is directed, among them orphans, the poor and the wayfarer.
«ولا يحض على طعام المسكين»: سورة الماعون: Not urging the feeding of the poor, in Surat al-Ma'un
ذكر ترك الحضّ على طعام المسكين في وصف ال: The mention of not urging the feeding of the poor in describing the one who denies the Judgement.
«إنه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم ولا يحض عل: Not urging the feeding of the poor, in Surat al-Haqqa
ذكر ترك الحضّ على طعام المسكين في سبب عذ: The mention of not urging the feeding of the poor among the reasons for the punishment of the one given his record in his left hand.
«كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم ولا تحاضون على: Not urging one another to feed the poor
ذكر ترك التحاضّ على طعام المسكين مع إكرا: The mention of not urging one another to feed the poor, together with not honouring the orphan and consuming inheritance greedily.
«ولم نك نطعم المسكين»: من أسباب سقر: The answer of the people of the right
جواب أصحاب اليمين للمجرمين بأنهم لم يكون: The reply to the wrongdoers in Surat al-Muddaththir that they did not feed the poor.
قصة أصحاب الجنة الذين أقسموا ليصرمنها مص: The story of the owners of the garden who swore to pick its fruit at dawn and whispered that no poor person should enter it.
وصف ضيف إبراهيم عليه السلام بأنهم المكرم: The description of the guests of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) as the honoured ones, and his bringing them a fat roasted calf.
قول لوط عليه السلام لقومه في أضيافه: «فل: The words of Lut (peace be upon him) to his people about his guests: "so do not disgrace me" and "do not shame me before my guests".
«استطعما أهلها فأبوا أن يضيفوهما»: The town that refused to host
خبر القرية التي استطعمها موسى والخضر علي: The report of the town whose people were asked for food by Musa and al-Khidr (peace be upon them) and refused to host them.
قول يوسف عليه السلام لإخوته: «وأنا خير ا: The words of Yusuf (peace be upon him) to his brothers: "and I am the best of hosts".
ذكر ابن السبيل مع ذي القربى والمسكين في: The mention of the wayfarer together with the relative and the poor in the command to give each his due.
«ليس عليكم جناح أن تأكلوا من بيوتكم أو ب: Eating in the homes of relatives and friends
رفع الحرج في الأكل من بيوت الأقارب والأص: The removal of blame in eating from the homes of relatives and friends, together or separately.
أدب دخول بيوت النبي ﷺ لطعام، وعدم انتظار: The manner of entering the houses of the Prophet ﷺ for a meal, not waiting for it to be cooked, and dispersing after eating.
جعل إطعام عشرة مساكين أحد خصال كفارة الي: Making the feeding of ten poor persons one of the options in the expiation of an oath.
إطعام ستين مسكيناً خصلةً في كفارة الظهار: The feeding of sixty poor persons in the expiation of zihar for one who cannot fast.
«فكلوا منها وأطعموا البائس الفقير»: Eating from the sacrificial animals and feeding the needy
الأمر بالأكل من الهدي وإطعام البائس الفق: The command to eat from the sacrificial animals and to feed the desperately poor, the one who is content and the one who asks.
فرض الصيام وحكمته، وفيها ترك الأكل والشر: The prescription of fasting and its wisdom, which includes leaving food and drink and the sharing of the poor's hunger.
«وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية طعام مسكين»: The ransom of feeding a poor person
The ransom of feeding a poor person in place of fasting, in the verse of fasting.
إباحة الأكل والشرب حتى تبيّن الفجر ثم إت: The permission to eat and drink until dawn is clear, then completing the fast until night.
أي الإسلام خير: تطعم الطعام: Which Islam is best: you feed food
تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلاَ: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ: "Which Islam is best?" He said: "That you feed food, and give the greeting of peace to those you know and those you do not know."
فكّوا العاني وأطعموا الجائع: Free the captive and feed the hungry
فُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ ـ يَعْنِي الأَسِيرَ ـ: "Free the captive" — meaning the prisoner — "feed the hungry, and visit the sick."
ما اجتمعن في امرئ إلا دخل الجنة: These do not gather in a person but he enters Paradise
مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ صَائِمً: "Who among you is fasting today?" Abu Bakr said: "I am." He said: "Who among you has followed a funeral today?" Abu Bakr said: "I have." He said: "Who among you has fed a poor person today?" Abu Bakr said: "I have." He said: "Who among you has visited a sick person today?" Abu Bakr said: "I have." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "These do not gather in a person but he enters Paradise."
استطعمتك فلم تطعمني: I asked you for food and you did not feed Me
يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ اسْتَطْعَمْتُكَ فَلَمْ ت: "O son of Adam, I asked you for food and you did not feed Me." He says: "My Lord, how could I feed You when You are the Lord of the worlds?" He says: "Did you not know that My servant so-and-so asked you for food and you did not feed him? Did you not know that had you fed him you would have found that with Me?"
من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليكرم ضي: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his guest
مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْم: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his guest; his due is a day and a night, and hospitality is three days, and what is beyond that is charity."
فخذوا منهم حق الضيف: Take from them the guest's due
إِنْ نَزَلْتُمْ بِقَوْمٍ، فَأُمِرَ لَكُم: "If you stay with a people and they order for you what is fitting for a guest, accept it; and if they do not, take from them the guest's due."
لقد عجب الله من فلان وفلانة: Allah marvelled at so-and-so and so-and-so
أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عل: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, hardship has afflicted me." He sent to his wives but found nothing with them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Is there no man who will host this one tonight, Allah have mercy on him?" A man of the Ansar stood and said: "I will, O Messenger of Allah." He went to his wife and said: "The guest of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ — keep nothing back from him." She said: "By Allah, I have nothing but the children's food." He said: "When the children want their supper, put them to sleep, then come and put out the lamp, and we shall go hungry tonight." She did so. Then the man went in the morning to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: "Allah marvelled — or laughed — at so-and-so and so-and-so."
إذا دُعي أحدكم إلى الوليمة فليأتها: When one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him come
إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْوَلِيمَ: "When one of you is invited to the wedding feast, let him come to it."
قسمة لحوم الهدي على المساكين: Distributing the meat of the sacrificial animals to the poor
أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ وَأ: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ commanded him to see to his sacrificial camels and commanded him to distribute all of them — their meat, their hides and their covers — among the poor.
للصائم فرحتان: The fasting person has two joys
قَالَ اللَّهُ كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ ل: Allah said: "Every deed of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting, for it is Mine and I reward for it. Fasting is a shield. On the day one of you fasts, let him not use foul speech nor shout; and if someone insults him or fights him, let him say: I am a fasting man. By Him in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the odour of the fasting person's mouth is better with Allah than the scent of musk. The fasting person has two joys: when he breaks his fast he rejoices, and when he meets his Lord he rejoices in his fast."
تسحّروا فإن في السحور بركة: Eat the pre-dawn meal, for in it is blessing
تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السَّحُورِ بَرَك: "Eat the pre-dawn meal, for in the pre-dawn meal there is blessing."
لاَ يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّل: "People will remain in good as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast."
معنى البر وصوره: الآية الجامعة في البقرة: The meaning and forms of birr: the comprehensive verse in al-Baqara, kindness to parents, to relatives, orphans and the needy, cooperation in birr, and the abrar and their reward, with verses in the Mushaf script and the exegetes' words verbatim.
الجود والكرم والإنفاق والصدقة، ومساعدة ا: Generosity, spending and charity, helping the needy and the poor, caring for orphans and the unmarried and bereaved, the manners and fruit of giving and the end of miserliness, with verses in the Mushaf script, the exegetes' words and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim verbatim.
آداب التعامل بين الناس وأخلاقه: الصدق وا: The manners and ethics of dealing between people: truthfulness, keeping covenants, testimony, justice, reconciliation, pardon, the etiquette of neighbours and gatherings, and the right of the needy, with verses in the Mushaf script and the exegetes' words verbatim.
التطوع والعمل الجماعي والتعاون على الخير: Volunteering, collective action and cooperation in goodness in the Quran and Sunnah
مواضع القرآن في التطوع بالخير والمسارعة: The Quranic passages on volunteering in good, hastening to good deeds and vying in them, cooperation in righteousness and God-consciousness, brotherhood and mutual counsel, the community that calls to good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and the upkeep of mosques and giving water to pilgrims, with verses in the Mushaf script, the exegetes' words verbatim and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim.
حدود الباب: آيات التطوع والمسارعة والتعا: Scope: verses on volunteering, hastening, cooperation, collective action, calling to good and the upkeep of mosques. The Quran uses the verb "tatawwa'a" (to volunteer) and the noun "al-muttawwi'in" (the volunteers); the exact expressions "collective action" and "voluntary work" do not occur in it, and this chapter presents the verses that point to their meaning. From the verse "cooperate in righteousness and God-consciousness" this chapter keeps only the side of not cooperating in sin and aggression. For the forms of birr, its comprehensive verse and kindness to parents and relatives see "Birr in the Noble Quran"; for spending and charity see "O that I had sent ahead for my life"; for the etiquette of dealing with people see "Dealings"; and for the attributes of believers see "Attributes of the Believer".
التطوع بالخير والمسارعة إلى الخيرات والت: Volunteering in good, hastening to good deeds, cooperation in righteousness and God-consciousness, the community that calls to good and the upkeep of mosques, with verses in the Mushaf script, the exegetes' words and the hadiths of the two Sahihs verbatim.
الآيات التي ورد فيها لفظ التطوع بالخير:: The verses in which volunteering in good is mentioned by name: "whoever volunteers good", the description of the believers who volunteer in charity, and what is said of doing good in general, that Allah knows it and it will not be denied.
المسارعة إلى الخيرات والاستباق: Hastening to good deeds and vying in them
الآيات التي أمرت بالمسارعة إلى المغفرة و: The verses that command hastening to forgiveness and Paradise and vying in good deeds, describe the prophets and the believers as hastening to good deeds, and mention those who are foremost in good deeds.
الآيات التي جعلت المؤمنين إخوة وصفّاً مر: The verses that make the believers brothers and a firmly compacted line, command holding fast together and avoiding division, forbid cooperation in sin and aggression, mention mutual counsel to truth, patience and compassion, and help in good between two brothers and for the good of the community.
الأمة الداعية إلى الخير والأمر بالمعروف: The community that calls to good and enjoins what is right
الآيات التي ذكرت أمة تدعو إلى الخير وتأم: The verses that mention a community calling to good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, the excellence of this community, calling to Allah in word and deed, the remnant who set things right, and the censure of leaving wrongdoing unchecked.
عمارة المساجد وسقاية الحاج: The upkeep of mosques and giving water to pilgrims
الآيات التي ذكرت من يعمر مساجد الله، وسق: The verses that mention those who maintain the mosques of Allah, giving water to pilgrims and the upkeep of the Sacred Mosque, and those who, when Allah gives them authority in the land, establish prayer, give zakat and enjoin what is right.
ورود لفظ التطوع بالخير في الحج والصيام،: The mention of volunteering in good in connection with Hajj and fasting, and the statement that Allah is Appreciative and All-Knowing.
«الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في ال: The believers who volunteer in charity
وصف المؤمنين الذين يتطوعون بالصدقات، وما: The description of the believers who give voluntary charity, and what the hypocrites said about them.
«وما تفعلوا من خير يعلمه الله» و«فلن يكف: Whatever good you do, Allah knows it
عموم قوله «وما تفعلوا من خير يعلمه الله»: The generality of "whatever good you do, Allah knows it", and that good that is done will not be denied.
«فاستبقوا الخيرات»: Vie with one another in good deeds
الأمر بالاستباق إلى الخيرات وما يؤخذ منه: The command to vie in good deeds and what is drawn from it about hastening to virtuous acts.
«وسارعوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم» و«سابقوا إلى: Hasten and race to forgiveness and Paradise
الأمر بالمسارعة والمسابقة إلى مغفرة الله: The command to hasten and race to Allah's forgiveness and His Paradise.
«إنهم كانوا يسارعون في الخيرات»: الأنبيا: They used to hasten to good deeds
وصف الأنبياء والمؤمنين المشفقين بأنهم يس: The description of the prophets and of the apprehensive believers as hastening to good deeds and being foremost in them.
«ومنهم سابق بالخيرات» و«والسابقون السابق: The one foremost in good deeds
ذكر السابق بالخيرات من الأصناف الثلاثة،: The mention of the one foremost in good deeds among the three groups, and of the foremost who are brought near.
«ولا تعاونوا على الإثم والعدوان»: Do not cooperate in sin and aggression
النهي عن التعاون على الإثم والعدوان، وبي: The prohibition of cooperating in sin and aggression and the meaning of sin and aggression. The command to cooperate in righteousness and God-consciousness is in the chapter on birr.
عقد الأخوة بين المؤمنين وما يقتضيه من مح: The bond of brotherhood between believers and the mutual love it requires.
«كأنهم بنيان مرصوص»: As though they were a firmly compacted structure
وصف المقاتلين في سبيل الله صفاً كأنهم بن: The description of those who fight in Allah's way in a rank as though they were a firmly compacted structure.
«واعتصموا بحبل الله جميعاً ولا تفرقوا»: Hold firmly together to the rope of Allah
الأمر بالاعتصام بحبل الله وعدم التفرق وت: The command to hold firmly to the rope of Allah and not to divide, and the reminder of the blessing of union.
«وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر» و«وتواصوا: Counselling one another to truth, patience and compassion
وصف الذين آمنوا بالتواصي بالحق والصبر وا: The description of those who believed as counselling one another to truth, to patience and to compassion.
طلب العون في الخير: ذو القرنين وقومه، وم: Seeking help in a good cause: Dhu al-Qarnayn and the people, and Musa and his brother Harun.
«ولتكن منكم أمة يدعون إلى الخير»: Let there be among you a community calling to good
الأمر بأن تكون من الجماعة أمة تدعو إلى ا: The command that there be, from among the believers, a community calling to good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong.
«كنتم خير أمة أخرجت للناس»: The best community brought out for mankind
وصف الأمة بأنها خير أمة أخرجت للناس بالأ: The description of the community as the best brought out for mankind through enjoining what is right, forbidding what is wrong and faith.
«يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر» و«وأم: Enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong
وصف المؤمنين والمؤمنات بالأمر بالمعروف و: The description of believing men and women as enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and Luqman's counsel to his son about it.
«ومن أحسن قولاً ممن دعا إلى الله وعمل صا: Who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah
ثناء الله على من دعا إلى الله وعمل صالحا: Allah's praise of one who calls to Allah and does righteous deeds, and a statement of the forms of calling.
«أولو بقية ينهون عن الفساد في الأرض» و«أ: A remnant who forbid corruption, and a community who guide by truth
بقية أهل الخير الذين ينهون عن الفساد، وأ: The remnant of the people of good who forbid corruption in the land, and a community of people who guide by the truth and act justly by it.
«كانوا لا يتناهون عن منكر فعلوه»: They did not forbid one another any wrong they did
The censure of those who did not forbid one another any wrong they committed.
وصف عمّار مساجد الله بالإيمان وإقامة الص: The description of those who maintain Allah's mosques by faith, establishing prayer, giving zakat and fearing none but Allah.
الموازنة بين سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد ا: The comparison between giving water to pilgrims and tending the Sacred Mosque and faith and striving in Allah's way.
«الذين إن مكناهم في الأرض أقاموا الصلاة: Those whom, if We give them authority in the land
وصف من مكّنهم الله في الأرض بإقامة الصلا: The description of those whom Allah gives authority in the land: they establish prayer, give zakat, enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong.
أَخْبِرْنِي مَاذَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَىّ: A Bedouin with dishevelled hair came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, tell me what Allah has made obligatory for me of prayer." He said: "The five prayers, unless you volunteer something." He said: "Tell me what Allah has made obligatory for me of fasting." He said: "The month of Ramadan, unless you volunteer something." Then he said: "Tell me what Allah has made obligatory for me of zakat," and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed him of the laws of Islam. He said: "By the One who honoured you, I will not volunteer anything, nor will I reduce anything of what Allah has made obligatory on me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He has succeeded if he is truthful," or "He will enter Paradise if he is truthful."
بَادِرُوا بِالأَعْمَالِ فِتَنًا كَقِطَعِ: "Hasten to do good deeds before trials like pieces of the dark night, in which a man will be a believer in the morning and a disbeliever in the evening, or a believer in the evening and a disbeliever in the morning, selling his religion for a trifle of this world."
المؤمن للمؤمن كالبنيان: The believer to the believer is like a building
إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْ: "The believer to the believer is like a building, each part strengthening the other," and he interlaced his fingers.
مثل المؤمنين في توادهم وتراحمهم: The likeness of the believers in mutual love and mercy
الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِ: "A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not wrong him and does not abandon him. Whoever is in the need of his brother, Allah is in his need; whoever relieves a Muslim of a distress, Allah will relieve him by it of a distress of the Day of Resurrection; and whoever covers a Muslim, Allah will cover him on the Day of Resurrection."
من دلّ على خير فله مثل أجر فاعله: Whoever guides to good has the like of the reward of its doer
جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله ع: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "My mount has been exhausted, so carry me." He said: "I have nothing." A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, I will direct him to one who will carry him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever guides to good has the like of the reward of its doer."
مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ ا: "Whoever calls to guidance will have a reward like the rewards of those who follow him, without that diminishing their rewards in the least; and whoever calls to misguidance will bear a sin like the sins of those who follow him, without that diminishing their sins in the least."
تغيير المنكر باليد واللسان والقلب: Changing wrong by hand, tongue and heart
مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيّ: "Whoever of you sees a wrong, let him change it with his hand; if he cannot, then with his tongue; and if he cannot, then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith."
مثل القائم على حدود الله والواقع فيها: The likeness of one who upholds Allah's limits and one who transgresses them
مَثَلُ الْقَائِمِ عَلَى حُدُودِ اللَّهِ: "The likeness of one who upholds the limits of Allah and one who transgresses them is like a people who cast lots for a ship: some got its upper deck and some its lower. Those on the lower deck, when they drew water, would pass by those above them, and they said: "If we made a hole in our share and did not harm those above us." If they leave them to what they intend, all will perish; but if they take them by the hand, they will be saved, and all will be saved."
الإنفاق في الأزمات وتفريج الكرب وإنظار ا: Spending in Times of Crisis, Relieving Distress and Granting Respite to the Debtor in Hardship, in the Quran and Sunnah
الآيات التي جاءت في إنظار المعسر والتصدق: The verses on granting respite to the debtor in hardship and giving charity to him, on easing what is owed, on freeing necks and helping toward it, on those burdened by debt, on spending in times of need and hunger, on trial, patience under it and keeping hope alive, and on the brotherhood of the believers and their mutual help, with verses in the Mushaf script and the exegetes' words verbatim, together with the Sahihayn hadiths on relieving a believer's distress, granting respite to the debtor in hardship and overlooking his debt, concealing a Muslim's faults and helping the one in distress.
حدود الباب: يجمع الباب الآيات المتعلقة ب: Scope: this section gathers the verses on granting respite to the debtor in hardship and easing matters for him, on freeing the neck and the expiations, on those burdened by debt, on spending in hardship, and on trial and mutual support, with the words of al-Sa'di and Ibn Kathir on them verbatim and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim verbatim. The phrases "relieving distress", "concealing a Muslim's faults" and "helping the one in distress" are wording of the hadith and not of the Quran; the Quran uses the words hardship and ease, respite until ease, the neck, those in debt, hunger, trial, brotherhood and good intercession. Respite for the debtor appears in the sound hadiths with wording such as "overlook his debt" and "let him relieve one in hardship or remit from him"; the hadith "whoever gives respite to one in hardship, Allah will shade him in His shade" is not included because in Sahih Muslim it forms part of a long hadith. Generosity and charity in general belong to the section on generosity, patience and its kinds to the section on patience, and the rulings on debt and usury to the section on Fiqh from the Noble Quran.
تفريج الكرب وإنظار المعسر: Relieving distress and respite for the debtor
إنظار المعسر والتصدق عليه، وفك الرقاب وا: Respite for the debtor in hardship and charity to him, freeing necks and those burdened by debt, spending in times of hardship, patience in trial, mutual support and concealing a Muslim's faults, with the verses, the commentators and the Sahihayn hadiths.
إنظار المعسر والتيسير: Respite for the debtor and ease
الآيات التي أمرت بإمهال المدين المعسر إل: The verses that command giving the debtor in hardship time until ease and encourage giving charity to him, that announce that with hardship comes ease, that make clear that Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity, and that guide to documenting a debt in writing.
الآيات التي ذكرت فك الرقبة وعدّته اقتحام: The verses that mention freeing a neck and count it as scaling the steep path, that make "necks" a head of expenditure of charity, that command contracting with one who asks for a writ of emancipation and helping him, and that require freeing a neck in some expiations.
الغارمون والإنفاق وقت الحاجة: Those in debt and spending in time of need
الآيات التي ذكرت الغارمين في مصارف الصدق: The verses that mention those in debt among the heads of charity, feeding on a day of hunger, spending of the surplus, and urging the feeding of the needy.
الابتلاء والصبر وإحياء الرجاء: Trial, patience and keeping hope alive
الآيات التي أخبرت بابتلاء المؤمنين بالخو: The verses that announce the testing of the believers with fear, hunger and loss of wealth and lives, Allah's way of testing before victory, the prohibition of despair and hopelessness, and mutual counsel to patience and mercy.
الأخوّة والتكافل وستر المؤمنين: Brotherhood, mutual support and concealing the believers' faults
الآيات التي جعلت المؤمنين إخوة، وحثّت عل: The verses that make the believers brothers, that urge good intercession and cooperation, that establish the bond of support among the believers, and that guard their honour against the spreading of indecency and backbiting.
«وإن كان ذو عسرة فنظرة إلى ميسرة»: Giving the debtor in hardship time until ease
The command to give the debtor in hardship time until ease.
«وأن تصدقوا خير لكم»: التصدق على المعسر: Giving charity to the debtor by remitting the debt
الندب إلى التصدق على المعسر بإسقاط الدين: The encouragement to give charity to the one in hardship by remitting the debt, whole or part.
البشارة بأن الله يجعل بعد العسر يسراً، و: The glad tidings that Allah will make ease after hardship, and that with hardship comes ease.
«لا يكلف الله نفساً إلا وسعها»: التيسير: Allah burdens no soul beyond its capacity
أن الله لا يكلّف نفساً إلا وسعها، وإرادت: That Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity, and that He intends ease for His servants.
الأمر بكتابة الدين إذا كان إلى أجل مسمى: The command to write down a debt for a stated term, to protect rights.
«فلا اقتحم العقبة... فك رقبة»: Freeing a neck as scaling the steep path
عدّ فك الرقبة والإطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة ا: Counting the freeing of a neck and feeding on a day of hunger as scaling the steep path.
«وفي الرقاب»: الرقاب في مصارف الصدقات: Necks as a head of charity
ذكر «الرقاب» مصرفاً من مصارف الصدقات، ود: The mention of "necks" as one of the heads of charity, and the inclusion in it of emancipation and the ransom of captives.

الأمر بمكاتبة من طلب الكتابة وإيتائه من: The command to contract with one who asks for a writ of emancipation and to give him of Allah's wealth.

نصوص الآيات بلفظ مصحف المدينة النبوية وب: The verses are in the Madina Mushaf text and script. The exegetes' words are excerpted verbatim from their books bundled in the site: al-Sa'di's Taysir, Ibn Kathir's tafsir and al-Qurtubi's al-Jami' li-Ahkam al-Quran. The hadiths are from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, verbatim and with their numbers; no hadith from any other collection is counted among the chapter's hadiths. The exegetes mention the hadith "Beware of the firasa of the believer, for he sees with the light of Allah"; al-Tirmidhi said of it: gharib (reported only through one line), scholars have discussed its chains, and it is not in the two Sahihs; so it appears here only where an exegete mentions it in his words, and is not attributed to us. What al-Qurtubi relates of the Companions and the early generations is in the form "it is related", and we did not verify its chains. A mark "…" shows omitted text between excerpts. Firasa here means inference from signs, reflection and understanding; it is not knowledge of the unseen and not a legal ruling. This chapter is for reflection and study and is not a fatwa; refer to scholars for particular cases.
الفراسة في القرآن الكريم: المتوسمون، وال: Firasa in the Noble Quran: the mutawassimin, the marks (sima), the tone of speech, the insight of the prophets and the righteous, inference from circumstantial evidence, and its limits; with the verses in Mushaf script, the exegetes' words and the hadiths of al-Bukhari and Muslim verbatim, and an English meaning for every text.
لفظ «الفراسة» بعينه لم يرد في القرآن؛ وإ: The word "firasa" itself does not occur in the Quran; what occurs is "al-mutawassimin" in Surat al-Hijr, which the exegetes explained as those who discern, who reflect and who look, and the idea of inferring from signs occurs in "sima" (marks), "the tone of speech" and elsewhere. So this chapter gathers what relates to it of verses, stories and exegesis. It does not repeat "Taqwa in the Quran", "The attributes of the believer", "The stories of the Quran" or "The prophets and messengers", but refers to them.

النور الذي يمشي به المؤمن في الناس والذي: The light by which the believer walks among people, which Allah grants to those who have taqwa.
The meaning of insight (basira) and its being the way of calling to Allah.
فراسة عزيز مصر: «أكرمي مثواه عسى أن ينفع: The governor of Egypt and Yusuf
توسّم عزيز مصر في يوسف عليه السلام، وقول: The governor of Egypt's insight into Yusuf, peace be upon him, and the saying of Ibn Masud about the most perceptive of people.
«إنا نراك من المحسنين»: توسّم صاحبَي الس: The two prison companions and Yusuf
What the two prison companions saw in Yusuf of excellence of conduct.
استدلال يعقوب عليه السلام من القرائن على: Yaqub's inference, peace be upon him, from the circumstances that his sons were lying.
«وشهد شاهد من أهلها»: الاستدلال بالقرينة: The witness and the torn shirt
شهادة الشاهد بقرينة موضع القدّ في القميص: The witness's testimony by the evidence of where the shirt was torn, and the hadith of the physiognomist in the Sunnah.
«يا أبت استأجره إن خير من استأجرت القوي: The daughter of the man of Madyan and Musa
حكم ابنة صاحب مدين على موسى عليه السلام: The judgment of the daughter of the man of Madyan on Musa, peace be upon him, that he was strong and trustworthy.
فهم سليمان للقضية وكيف قضى الله له بالفه: Sulayman's understanding of the case, and how Allah gave him the understanding.
اختبار سليمان لبلقيس وجوابها الدال على ف: Sulayman's test of Bilqis and her answer that shows her discernment.
«لعلمه الذين يستنبطونه منهم»: الاستنباط: Referring matters to those who can deduce
Referring a matter to those who can deduce from it, and the manner of verification.
الأمر بالتثبت من خبر الفاسق واعتبار القر: The command to verify the report of a wrongdoer and to take the circumstantial evidence into account.
«وإذا رأيتهم تعجبك أجسامهم»: لا يُغتر با: Appearance and words are not enough
أن المظهر والقول وحدهما ليسا دليلاً، وأن: That appearance and speech alone are not evidence, and that judgment is by what is apparent, in the Sunnah.
«لا تعلمهم نحن نعلمهم»: العلم بالسرائر ل: Knowledge of hidden things belongs to Allah
انفراد الله بعلم الغيب والسرائر، وأن الن: Allah alone has knowledge of the unseen and of hearts, and the Prophet ﷺ was not commanded to search the hearts of people.
الفراسة لا يُبنى عليها حكم: قول ابن العر: Firasa is not a basis for a ruling
قول القاضي أبي بكر بن العربي إن الفراسة: The statement of al-Qadi Abu Bakr ibn al-Arabi that no ruling is built on firasa.
النهي عن الظن الخالي من الحقيقة والقرينة: The prohibition of suspicion that is empty of truth and of evidence.
من الأمم قبلنا «محدَّثون»: Among the nations before us there were "inspired ones"
لَقَدْ كَانَ فِيمَا قَبْلَكُمْ مِنَ الأُ: There were among the nations before you people who were inspired (muhaddathun); and if there is anyone of them in my community, it is Umar.
قَدْ كَانَ يَكُونُ فِي الأُمَمِ قَبْلَكُ: Among the nations before you there used to be inspired ones; if there is any of them in my community, then Umar ibn al-Khattab is among them. Ibn Wahb said: the meaning of "muhaddathun" is "those who are inspired" (mulhamun).
قول ابن عمر في ظنون عمر رضي الله عنهما (: Ibn Umar on Umar's impressions (the opening of the hadith)
مَا سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، لِشَىْءٍ قَطُّ يَقُ: Abdullah ibn Umar said: I never heard Umar say about something, "I think it is such-and-such," except that it was as he thought.
آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ: The sign of the hypocrite is three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is entrusted he betrays.
علامة الإيمان وعلامة النفاق: The sign of faith and the sign of hypocrisy
آيَةُ الإِيمَانِ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ، وَآي: The sign of faith is love of the Ansar, and the sign of hypocrisy is hatred of the Ansar.
سرور النبي ﷺ بقول القائف مجزِّز: The Prophet's delight at the words of the physiognomist Mujazziz
إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: Aisha said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came in to her happy, the lines of his face shining, and said: "Have you not seen that Mujazziz looked just now at Zayd ibn Haritha and Usama ibn Zayd and said: These feet are from one another?"
عمر: نأخذكم بما ظهر لنا من أعمالكم: Umar: we judge you by what appears to us of your deeds
سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى ا: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: People used to be taken to account by revelation in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and revelation has ceased. We now take you by what appears to us of your deeds. Whoever shows us good, we trust him and bring him near, and nothing of his inner self is our concern: Allah reckons with him for his inner self. Whoever shows us evil, we do not trust him or believe him, even if he says his inner self is good.
لعل بعضكم ألحن بحجته من بعض: Perhaps one of you is more eloquent in his argument than another
إِنَّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ إِلَىَّ، وَلَعَل: You bring your disputes to me, and perhaps some of you are more eloquent in his argument than others. So whoever I judge for with something of his brother's right by his words, I am only cutting off for him a piece of the Fire, so let him not take it.
لم أومر أن أنقب عن قلوب الناس: I have not been commanded to search the hearts of people
فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ غَائِرُ الْعَيْنَيْنِ، مُ: Then a man with sunken eyes, prominent cheekbones, a raised forehead, a thick beard and a shaved head, with his garment tucked up, stood and said: "O Messenger of Allah, fear Allah." He said: "Woe to you! Am I not the most deserving of the people of the earth to fear Allah?" Then the man turned away. Khalid ibn al-Walid said: "O Messenger of Allah, shall I not strike off his neck?" He said: "No; perhaps he prays." Khalid said: "How many a one who prays says with his tongue what is not in his heart!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have not been commanded to search the hearts of people, nor to split open their bellies."
معنى التقوى وثمراتها، ومنها الفرقان والن: The meaning of taqwa and its fruits, among them the criterion and the light.
الصفات التي وصف الله بها المؤمنين الصادق: The attributes with which Allah described the sincere believers.
The stories of the prophets and the righteous with their lessons.
الأنبياء المذكورون بأسمائهم بترتيبهم الز: The prophets mentioned by name, in their chronological order.
The kinds of people in the Quran, among them the hypocrites.
The manners and ethics of dealing between people.
بدأت التلاوة من آخر موضع: Recitation started from the last place
اختر قارئك، واستمع، وضع علامة حيث تتوقف: Choose your reciter, listen, and place a bookmark where you stop
اختر القارئ من البطاقات واستمع إلى نموذج: Pick a reciter from the cards and hear a sample of the recitation, then start from any surah and verse. Place a bookmark where you stop so you can return to it at any time.
القرآن الكريم كاملاً من الفاتحة: The whole Holy Quran from al-Fatihah
افتح القرآن الكريم لمتابعتها: Open the Holy Quran to follow along
رقم الآية غير صحيح لهذه السورة: This verse number is not valid for this surah
الباب #: غريب القرآن: Chapter #: Unusual words of the Quran (gharib)
الإتقان للسيوطي، في معرفة غريبه؛ مفردات: Al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on knowing its unusual words; Mufradat Alfaz al-Quran by al-Raghib al-Isfahani; Nuzhat al-Qulub by al-Sijistani.
Al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on knowing its unusual words; Mufradat Alfaz al-Quran by al-Raghib al-Isfahani; Nuzhat al-Qulub by al-Sijistani
غريب القرآن: الألفاظ التي يخفى معناها عل: Gharib al-Quran: the words whose meaning is hidden from one who has not mastered the Arabs' language and its connotations. The Companions and Successors took care of it, foremost among them Abdullah ibn Abbas, the interpreter of the Quran, and then works followed one another on the subject.
ذكر السيوطي في الإتقان مسائل نافع بن الأ: Al-Suyuti mentions in al-Itqan the questions of Nafi ibn al-Azraq to Ibn Abbas on the unusual words of the Quran, in which he explains each word and cites Arabian poetry for its meaning.
من أشهر المصنفات فيه: غريب القرآن لابن ق: Among the best-known works on it: Gharib al-Quran by Ibn Qutaybah, Nuzhat al-Qulub by Abu Bakr al-Sijistani, and Mufradat Alfaz al-Quran by al-Raghib al-Isfahani.
مثال التوقف في الغريب: لما قرأ عمر رضي ا: An example of restraint over unusual words: when Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, recited «and fruit and grass» and asked about the meaning of «abb», then said «We were forbidden to pry», as in Sahih al-Bukhari from Anas, may Allah be pleased with him.
يُفسَّر الغريب بما صحّ من النقل عن الصحا: An unusual word is explained by what is sound in the reports from the Companions and Successors, and by what the Arabic language and the context of the verse indicate, not by mere opinion.
الفواصل ورؤوس الآي: Verse endings and the closing words of verses (fawasil)
الباب #: الفواصل ورؤوس الآي: Chapter #: Verse endings and the closing words of verses (fawasil)
الإتقان للسيوطي، في فواصل الآي؛ البيان ف: Al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on the verse endings; al-Bayan fi Add Ay al-Quran by Abu Amr al-Dani; al-Burhan by al-Zarkashi.
Al-Itqan by al-Suyuti, on the verse endings; al-Bayan fi Add Ay al-Quran by Abu Amr al-Dani; al-Burhan by al-Zarkashi
الفاصلة: كلمة آخر الآية، وهي كقافية الشع: The fasilah is the last word of a verse, like the rhyme of poetry and its end-rhyme in position though not in nature, and a number of scholars distinguished the Quranic fasilah from artificial rhymed prose. It affects the counting of verses and the eloquence of composition.
عدد آيات القرآن على العدّ الكوفي المنسوب: The number of verses of the Quran by the Kufan count, attributed to Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, is six thousand two hundred and thirty-six; other schools of counting differ in some places.
من أغراض الفاصلة مراعاة نظم الآي: كحذف ا: Among the purposes of the fasilah is regard for the composition of verses, as in omitting the pronoun in «Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested [you]», meaning «detested you», for the sake of what precedes and follows.
ومنه تأخير الفاعل في «فأوجس في نفسه خيفة: Another is delaying the subject in «And Moses sensed fear within himself», for the sake of the verse endings while the meaning stays clear.
